title: Experienced social media Clipping  Manager
description:
We are hiring an experienced clipping campaign manager to run campaigns for an established trading education and mentorship brand.



You will manage the process from creator recruitment and campaign setup through submission reviews, fraud checks, payout recommendations, and performance reporting. Our goal is to generate legitimate traffic, qualified leads, and paying customers while protecting the campaign budget.



**Experienced applicants only. You must have personally managed paid clipping campaigns using Content Rewards and be able to demonstrate your work.**



Experience working with traders, futures/forex educators, financial creators, or high-ticket mentorship businesses is a strong advantage.



**What you will manage**



- Set up and manage Content Rewards campaigns, including briefs, approved footage, requirements, budgets, and payout limits.

- Recruit, screen, and onboard reliable clippers. Verify ownership of publishing accounts and review relevant work and available audience data.

- Maintain assignments, deadlines, draft approvals, revisions, live post links, and creator communication.

- Review clips for accuracy, quality, branding, appropriate disclosures, and a clear next step.

- Investigate signs of bought views, bots, engagement exchanges, undisclosed boosting, duplicate submissions, or manipulated evidence.

- Check available native analytics, traffic sources, audience geography, watch/retention data, and account history.

- Prepare evidence-based recommendations to approve, investigate, or reject submissions and payment requests. Escalate issues to platform support when needed.

- Set up creator-specific tracking and preserve referral information through landing pages, applications, bookings, and customer records.

- Match customer bonuses to verified payments and refunds under the agreed rules.

- Maintain a budget and performance dashboard covering delivery, traffic, qualified applications, attended calls, customers, collections, refunds, and acquisition cost.

- Recommend improvements based on actual results.



We need someone who can run the daily operation independently, keep records organized, and bring problems to us with evidence and a proposed solution.



**Required experience**



- Personally managed at least two paid clipping campaigns, including submission reviews and creator payment checks.

- Hands-on experience with Content Rewards beyond submitting your own clips.

- Experience reviewing suspicious traffic and documenting fraud investigations.

- Ability to distinguish genuine low-converting traffic from evidence of manipulated engagement.

- Experience maintaining campaign budgets, tracking links, spreadsheets, or CRM reports.

- Strong written English, reliable communication, and consistent follow-through.



**Strong advantages**



- Previous work with trading educators, traders, financial creators, or online mentorship businesses.

- Experience connecting short-form content to YouTube training, applications, sales calls, and verified purchases.

- Experience measuring paid membership acquisition and renewals.

- Ability to write practical procedures and train clippers to follow them.



**How to apply**



Start your application with **CLIPPING OPERATOR** and answer these questions:



1. **Describe two clipping campaigns you personally managed.** Include the niche, approximate budget, platforms, number of active clippers, your responsibilities, and results you can substantiate.

2. **Show your Content Rewards experience.** Share a short Loom walkthrough or screenshots demonstrating your campaign-management work. Use material you have permission to share and redact confidential information.

3. **Describe a specific fraud investigation.** What raised your concern, what evidence did you check, what action did you take, and what happened? Distinguish confirmed findings from suspicions.

4. **Explain your screening process.** How would you vet a clipper and review a suspicious submission before recommending payment?

5. **Explain your tracking experience.** How have you tracked clips through to leads or sales? What tools did you use, and how did you handle missing attribution?

6. **Describe any trading-industry experience.** Who did you work with, and what was your exact role?

7. **Provide your expected part-time rate, weekly availability, availability for Pacific Time check-ins, and earliest start date.**



Applications must include specific answers and evidence of relevant experience.



Shortlisted applicants will be interviewed and complete a paid trial assignment.



We are looking for an experienced operator who can build a reliable clipping operation and help us judge success through real business results.

title: Senior SSDI/SSI Case Manager (3+ yrs US disability law firm experience)
description:
OneAdvocate (oneadvocate.co) helps people get Social Security Disability benefits (SSDI and SSI). We're hiring our first experienced Case Manager to own the case management side of every case, working closely with our founder & CEO, attorney, and paralegal. 



This is not simply a "follow the checklist" role. You'll have real ownership and direct access to our leadership. This is a role for candidates who are looking for career growth and advancement. 



Schedule: Monday-Friday, 9am-6pm US Eastern Time



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Own a caseload of signed clients through every stage: initial application, reconsideration, hearing, and post-hearing

• Initial and recon: complete and file applications and appeals with clients by phone (disability reports, work history and function reports, online filings), and respond to SSA and DDS requests

• Medical records: request, track, and follow up with providers, and flag gaps before they hurt the case

• Hearing stage: track hearing notices and deadlines, keep the file complete, get evidence in on time, and prepare clients for what to expect, working with our CEO, attorney, and paralegal

• Post-hearing: track decisions, flag cases for appeal on time, and follow up with SSA until benefits and back pay are paid

• Keep clients informed with regular check-ins so no one feels forgotten

• Track every deadline, and escalate cases that need attorney review

• Help build our process: checklists, templates, SOPs, and feedback on our new case management system



WHAT YOU NEED

• 3+ years as an SSDI/SSI case manager for a US Social Security disability law firm or advocate firm (required)

• Hands-on experience moving cases through initial and reconsideration yourself (required)

• Hearing and post-hearing case management experience (strongly preferred)

• You know the SSA forms, appeal deadlines, and DDS process without looking them up

• Experience managing a large caseload in case management software (tell us which ones)

• Excellent written and spoken English, and a warm, patient phone manner with clients

• Careful handling of sensitive personal and medical information

• Reliable laptop, stable internet with backup, a headset, and a quiet workspace



WHAT WE OFFER

• Strong pay: $1,000-2,000/month based on experience. The top of the range is for candidates with hands-on experience across all four stages. Pay is reviewed as you grow.

• Direct hire, no agency taking a cut

• A founding team role on a small team, where your experience directly shapes how we work

• Modern tools, including AI tools that cut down the busywork

• Meaningful work: every case you move forward is someone getting the income they need to live



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the words "CASE MANAGER" so we know you read this post. Include:

1.  Your years of SSDI/SSI case management experience, the firms you did it for, and your typical caseload size

2.  Which stages you've handled yourself (initial, reconsideration, hearing, post-hearing), what you did at each, and which case management software you've used

3.  A 3-4 minute video (Loom or similar) covering: 

- A quick intro: the firms you've worked for, your role, and how long you were there

- How you run your caseload day to day: how many cases you handle, how you track deadlines, and which software you use

- One case you moved through more than one stage: what stage it started at, what you filed or did at each step, what went wrong, and how you handled it



Applications missing any of these will NOT be considered.

title: Pattern Maker & Grader – Custom Sports Apparel
description:
About Us

D2S Apparel is a custom apparel shop in Dighton, Massachusetts, specializing in screen printing and embroidery. We've outfitted hundreds of local teams, schools and organizations, including the Dighton-Rehoboth Regional School District. We're growing into custom-cut team garments and uniforms, and we need a skilled pattern maker and grader to build that line from the ground up.

The Role

You'll own the patterns behind our custom sports garments: jerseys, warm-ups, shorts, pinnies, hoodies, jackets and team uniforms across youth and adult sizing. You'll turn a coach's request or a designer's sketch into production-ready patterns, grade them across a full size run, and work with our designers and production team so every piece fits well on the field and decorates cleanly.

What You'll Do

• Draft original patterns and adapt existing blocks for athletic garments (jerseys, shorts, pants, outerwear, fleece and performance knits)

• Grade patterns across youth, women's and men's size ranges (YXS through 4XL+), keeping fit consistent at every size

• Build a library of base blocks and size specs we can reuse quickly for custom orders

• Create and maintain spec sheets and tech packs (measurements, points of measure, tolerances, seam and construction notes)

• Run fit sessions on samples, then correct patterns based on fit, stretch and athletic movement

• Plan patterns around decoration: logo and number placement, panel layouts for sublimation, embroidery and screen print zones

• Prepare markers and cutting layouts that make efficient use of fabric

• Work with our designers on new styles, and with customers or coaches on custom fit requests when needed

What We're Looking For

• 3+ years of pattern making and grading experience, ideally in activewear, team sports or performance apparel

• Strong understanding of knit and stretch fabrics (polyester performance knits, mesh, spandex blends, fleece) and how stretch affects fit

• Experience with digital pattern software such as Gerber AccuMark, Optitex, Tukatech, Lectra or CLO 3D (manual drafting skills are a plus)

• Solid grasp of garment construction, sewing methods and how patterns translate to production

• Accuracy with measurements, specs and grade rules

• Ability to manage several custom orders at once and hit team deadlines (season start dates don't move)

• Clear communication and comfort working in a small, hands-on shop

Nice to Have

• Experience with sublimated team uniforms (cut-and-sew panels, wraparound graphics)

• Background in sizing for youth sports, or for adaptive and specialty fits

• Marker making and fabric yield optimization

• 3D fit and virtual sampling (CLO 3D, Browzwear)

• Knowledge of sports uniform requirements (number sizes, placement rules for school and league play)

Why D2S

• Your work goes on the field: you'll see local teams wearing what you built

• Build a new product line from the start, with real influence over how it's done

• Small, team-first shop with direct access to the owner

• [Benefits: e.g., paid time off, flexible schedule, employee apparel discount]

How to Apply

 
 with the subject line "Pattern Maker & Grader" and include:

• Your resume

• A portfolio or samples of graded patterns, tech packs or finished garments (activewear or team apparel preferred)

• The pattern software you use

• Your availability and preferred arrangement (full-time, part-time or contract)

D2S Apparel is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Part-time Phone Recruiter (English) – Truck Driver Recruitment for Europe

We recruit experienced truck drivers for long-term jobs in the Netherlands and Germany. Drivers apply through a short online form. We need a friendly, organized recruiter to call them and check if they are a good fit.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

• Make 10–15 minute screening calls in English to truck drivers from Greece, Portugal, Lithuania, Latvia, Romania and other EU countries, using our call script

• Update each candidate's status and notes in our shared Google Sheet

• Listen to short voice recordings uploaded by candidates and rate them

• Excellent spoken English, clear and confident on the phone

• Experience in recruitment, call center or customer service (logistics or trucking is a plus)

• Accurate with data, comfortable with Google Sheets

title: $2k, $3k, $4k... doesn't matter. Good video editor? Name your price.
description:
$2k, $3k, $4k... doesn't matter. If you're good, name your price.



We're looking for a hungry, senior-level video editor to build the next wave of ads for our pet supplement brand. VSLs, AI-animation ads and AI UGC. You'll work directly with us.



-> The product

* Dog supplements.

* 7-figure brand, under a year old, on track for 8 figures this year

* Retention among the best in the industry. People actually reorder, so we can spend hard on the front end. When your ad wins, it gets real budget behind it (bigger bonuses for you...)



-> Current bottleneck

We have more winning angles and scripts than editing capacity. We need more volume AND more quality: finished 3-minute VSLs that stop the scroll, fewer revision rounds, and faster feedback loops from brief to live ad.



-> Why us

* Base: $2,000+ per month.

* $300 every time you hit a breakthrough.

* 5% of the ad spend on every ad you make fully yourself (our internal bounty program).

* $1,000 bonus for top editor of the month.

* Education on us: Evolve, RMBC 2, Zakaria's course, and anything else you ask for.

* As many 1:1s with the founder as you want.

* A real path: editor to creative strategist to CMO. Nothing stops you except your own will.



-> Don't apply if

* You're not ok with blunt feedback.

* You work at a slow pace. A 3-minute VSL is a one-day job for you, not a one-week project.

* You just go through the motions. We want thinkers.

* You want part-time, you're an agency, or you'd keep another job on the side. Full-time only, and you quit your current job cleanly.

* No experience with AI UGC/AI ANIMATIONS/AI SONGS (Fal.ai / Suno.ai / etc....)



-> What We're looking for

Editors who can THINK. Take what the script says and bring it to life. Animation, transitions, sound design, a cross-section, whatever makes the idea land.

Closing feedback loops is the most important thing in creative strategy. When we hand you an idea, we need speed AND quality.

We want editors who make our ideas better with AI. Especially hooks: we want the PERFECT clip to stop the scroll, and if we don't have it, you generate it. You should already live inside Veo, Seedance, Kling, HeyGen, Arcads and ElevenLabs.

We want clear communication. Ask us if something is unclear. Tell us if you're delayed. Bounce ideas off us, it shows you're thinking. And if you think we're wrong about an ad, say so and prove it. We love that.



-> Requirements

* You've edited for 7, 8 or 9-figure DTC brands, ideally health, supplements or pet, and you can prove it.

* You're a killer at VSLs, AI-animation ads and AI UGC.

* You're an AI geek.

* Your English is fluent enough to debate ideas with us. Accent doesn't matter. Articulating your thinking does.



-> How to apply

Put your price in the first line of your reply. Then fill out this form:



and reply here "Filled". If the form is missing, we won't review it.



-> How hiring works

1. A 15-minute call.

2. A paid test brief: a real VSL from our queue.

3. Onboarding. We move fast for the right person.



TLDR: We want talent, but hungry talent. If you can deliver what we're looking for, we'll make a lot of money together.

title: YouTube Thumbnail Designer (Star Wars) - Thumbnails for Lore and Explainer Videos
description:
We're hiring a thumbnail designer for a new YouTube channel of Star Wars lore videos: narrated explainers, rankings and "every type of…" breakdowns, 15–30 minutes long, about the characters, ships, armies and history of the galaxy. For each video you'll receive the title and a short summary, and you'll hand back a finished thumbnail in two versions. We're looking for someone to work with us on an ongoing basis.



A thumbnail has one job: make the right viewer click. This audience knows the universe in detail, so the details have to be right. A clone in the wrong legion's markings, or a lightsaber with the wrong hilt, loses them before they click.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Read the title and summary and pick the one picture worth the click: a character, a ship, a creature or a line-up.



- Build it from scratch. Create or source the art, cut it out clean, and light it so it stands off a dark background.



- Fix what AI image tools get wrong: helmets, hands, hilts, symbols and armour markings.



- Add 1–4 words that tease the video instead of repeating the title.



- Deliver 2 versions of each thumbnail so we can test them against each other with YouTube's Test & Compare.



- Check every thumbnail at phone size before you send it.



- Save the layered source file (PSD or similar) next to each export in our shared Google Drive.



THE STYLE



- One subject fills a third to half of the frame, sharp and saturated, on black or deep space.



- The colour comes from the subject: a lightsaber's glow on a face, a red rim light on a Sith, engine light on a hull.



- The words are heavy capitals in white with one word in yellow or red, such as "NEVER REPAIRED", "HE KNEW." or "WHO BUILT IT?".



- At most one arrow, from the words to the thing they're about.



- For "every type" and ranking videos: three vertical panels, each with one character over its own colour and a one- or two-word label under it.



- For long documentaries: a film poster look, with one painted scene and a title.



- No emojis, borders, logos or clutter.



Every thumbnail must show something the video really covers, and follow YouTube's thumbnail policies.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- A portfolio of YouTube thumbnails you designed yourself, ideally for Star Wars, film, gaming, anime or other lore channels.



- Strong Photoshop skills (or similar): cut-outs, lighting, glow, colour grading and type.



- Experience with AI image tools, and the eye to finish their output by hand so it looks film-accurate.



- A good knowledge of Star Wars: the films, The Clone Wars and the main games and books. You can tell a Phase I clone helmet from a Phase II.



- An eye for what gets clicks. You study what's working in a niche and can explain why a thumbnail works.



- Good written English, so the words on a thumbnail are short and correct.



- Reliable deadlines and clear communication.



- Bonus: experience with YouTube's Test & Compare.



Workload: To start, 4–5 videos a week, each with 2 thumbnail versions. This will grow.



Turnaround: Within 24 hours of receiving the title and summary.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word "blueberry" and include:



1. Your
 address



2. Your portfolio link (Behance, Google Drive or similar, set so anyone with the link can view)



3. Links to 3–5 YouTube videos that use thumbnails you designed (link the videos, not image files), the channel each one is for, and what you did on each



4. The YouTube channels you've designed thumbnails for, when, and how many thumbnails a week you made for each (or "none yet")



5. How you made one of the thumbnails you linked: where each picture in it came from, the tools you used and how long it took



6. Your current workload: how many thumbnails you design in a typical week, for how many clients, and how many more a week you could take on for us



7. A sample thumbnail (1280 x 720) for this imaginary video, "Why the Empire Stopped Using Clone Troopers", made for this application and shared as a Google Drive link anyone can view



8. The software you use, including any AI image tools



9. Your expected rate (per thumbnail or per month)



10. How quickly you usually deliver a thumbnail after receiving a brief, and the hours you work (Philippine time)



11. Your 
 username 



Applications that skip the code word or any of items 1–11 won't be reviewed.

title: Part-Time Virtual Bookkeeper | QuickBooks Online & Desktop
description:
Part-Time Virtual Bookkeeper | QuickBooks Online & Desktop



We’re hiring a certified bookkeeper with formal education in bookkeeping or accounting to maintain accurate, fully reconciled books for our businesses. This is a remote, part-time role that requires hands-on experience in both QuickBooks Online (QBO) and QuickBooks Desktop (QBD).



Responsibilities

- Categorize transactions, manage bank feeds, and investigate discrepancies in QBO and QBD.

- Complete monthly bank, credit card, and merchant account reconciliations.

- Track accounts payable and receivable, including outstanding bills and customer balances.

- Prepare monthly and quarterly profit and loss statements, balance sheets, and cash flow reports.

- Organize receipts, bills, and supporting documents to maintain a clear audit trail.

- Verify employee hours and process recurring payroll accurately and on time.



Required qualifications

- A recognized professional bookkeeping certification.

- Completed formal education in bookkeeping or accounting, such as a post-secondary certificate, diploma, or degree.

- At least five years of hands-on bookkeeping experience for North American businesses, including direct experience with both QBO and QBD.

- Experience completing reconciliations, preparing financial reports, and processing payroll.

- Confidence working in QuickBooks Desktop, including remote or hosted access and company file management.

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including lookup formulas and pivot tables.

- Clear spoken and written English, strong attention to detail, and a secure workspace with reliable internet and backup access.



Schedule

Part-time and remote, with some overlap during Calgary business hours for team communication and a weekly check-in.



How to apply

Put DOUBLE QUICKBOOKS at the top of your application and include the following.

1. Your current résumé or CV.

2. Your bookkeeping certification and the issuing organization.

3. Your bookkeeping or accounting qualification and the school where you studied.

4. The QuickBooks Desktop editions you’ve used, such as Pro, Premier, or Enterprise.

5. A brief example of bookkeeping work you personally handled for North American businesses in each platform. Tell us which reconciliations, month-end reports, or payroll tasks you were responsible for.

6. Your weekly availability and the hours you can overlap with Calgary business hours.

We are seeking a dynamic and talented General Program Manager to join our team. This role is perfect for a highly intelligent, motivated individual who is passionate about leveraging technology to make a difference in healthcare.



About AnsibleHealth

AnsibleHealth is a US medical group for people living with serious heart and lung disease, such as heart failure and COPD. Health systems and health plans send us their patients, often right after a hospital stay. You make 45 to 60 calls a day. Most go to voi

ABOUT ANSIBLEHEALTH

title: Short-Form Video Editor for social media
description:
We run an Instagram page built around Mel, a dog groomer character who specializes in doodles. Mel isn't a real person — she's fully AI-generated. Every video is made in Veo 3.



The page is growing and the bottleneck is production. We need someone who can sit down, generate, and deliver finished Reels without us hand-holding every prompt.



What you'll do:



Generate 6–10 finished Reels per week (20–40 seconds each) in Veo 3

Keep Mel consistent — same face, same hair, same salon, same voice, every single video. This is the hardest part of the job and the main thing we're hiring for.

Build scenes around a simple brief we give you: a dog, a grooming problem, a transformation, a product moment

Iterate on prompts until the shot is right. Most usable clips take several generations — that's expected, not a failure.

Assemble clips into a finished vertical Reel: pacing, cuts, captions, sound

Fix the AI tells before delivery — warped hands, morphing dogs, text glitches, uncanny motion. If it looks like AI slop, it doesn't ship.

Deliver in 9:16, ready to post, on a set weekly schedule

Track what works — pull IG insights and our affiliate numbers into a simple weekly sheet so we know which hooks and formats to make more of



What you're NOT doing: no posting (we publish), no writing captions or affiliate links, no customer messages. Produce and report — that's the role.



Tools — we provide everything:



You'll get logins for our Veo 3 access, editing software, and voice tools. You don't need to pay for anything. You do need a computer and internet that can handle generating and downloading video all day.



What we're looking for:



Hands-on Veo 3 experience. Not "I've used AI tools" — actual Veo 3 or Flow output you can show us.

A real method for character consistency across generations. If you know why this is hard, you're the person we want. If you don't, this role will frustrate both of us.

Strong prompt writing — you can describe a camera angle, a lighting setup, and a dog's coat texture in a way the model actually follows

Video editing in CapCut, Premiere, or Resolve — enough to cut, caption, and sound-design a Reel

Taste. You can tell the difference between a video that looks real and one that looks like AI. Most people can't.

Patient and systematic. This job is 80% iteration. Someone who gets discouraged by bad generations will hate it.

Comfortable with basic spreadsheets for the weekly performance report

A few hours of overlap with US Eastern Time

Good written English

Bonus: you know dogs, or you're willing to learn what a badly groomed doodle actually looks like



The setup:



20 hours per week, part-time, long-term

₱28,000 – ₱40,000/month depending on experience, paid twice monthly via Wise

Paid trial project before we commit long-term (details below)

Clear briefs, weekly check-in, no micromanaging



How to apply:



Send us:



Links to AI-generated video you personally made — Veo 3, Flow, Kling, Runway, Sora, whatever. Vertical short-form preferred. Tell us which model and what your prompt approach was.

Your answer to this: How do you keep the same character looking identical across 10 different AI-generated videos? Two or three sentences. We're testing whether you've actually done this.

Roughly how many generations it takes you to get one usable 8-second clip, honestly.

Your available hours in Philippine time.

Start your message with the word "DOODLE" so we know you read the post.



No video samples, no review. We're hiring one person for the long haul, so put a little effort in — we will too.



SKILL REQUIREMENTS (tag these on the listing)



Video Editing · AI Video Generation · Prompt Engineering · Content Creation · Instagram · CapCut · Adobe Premiere Pro · Social Media Marketing · Attention to Detail

title: Credentialing and Billing Specialist
description:
Position Summary:



The Credentialing and Billing Specialist manages provider credentialing and payer enrollment and supports accurate, timely billing for ASun Star’s behavioral health and related services in New Jersey and Pennsylvania. The specialist tracks each provider’s enrollment status by payer, program, and service location, then applies that information to billing so claims are submitted under the correct provider and location.



This role works closely with clinical leadership, intake, scheduling, and finance to resolve credentialing, authorization, and claims issues that can delay reimbursement.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Credentialing and Payer Enrollment



    Prepare, submit, and track initial credentialing, recredentialing, enrollment, and revalidation applications for individual providers and ASun Star entities, as applicable.

    Maintain current provider records, including licenses, NPIs, taxonomy codes, malpractice insurance, and CAQH profiles and attestations where required.

    Coordinate payer roster updates, group affiliations, practice location additions, and provider departures across New Jersey and Pennsylvania.

    Confirm and document payer approvals and effective dates by provider, program, and location. Communicate enrollment status and billing start dates to leadership, intake, and scheduling.

    Track renewal deadlines, follow up on outstanding applications, and escalate delays that may affect service scheduling or reimbursement.



Billing and Claims Follow-Up



    Verify insurance eligibility, benefits, and authorization requirements. Monitor authorization dates and remaining units where applicable, and flag gaps to the appropriate team.

    Review claims against service records and payer requirements. Check dates of service, procedure codes, modifiers, units, place of service, and rendering and billing provider information before submission.

    Submit claims and monitor clearinghouse and payer responses for rejected, denied, or unpaid claims.

    Investigate discrepancies, coordinate corrections with the responsible staff, and submit corrected claims, reconsiderations, or appeals within payer deadlines.

    Review remittance advice and coordinate with finance to reconcile payments, adjustments, and outstanding balances.

    Maintain a follow-up list for aging claims and report recurring issues, including credentialing mismatches, authorization gaps, and documentation delays.



Compliance and Reporting:



    Maintain organized, audit-ready credentialing and billing records and protect confidential provider and client information in accordance with HIPAA and ASun Star policies.

    Provide regular updates on pending enrollments, upcoming renewals, claim denials, aging balances, and issues that require leadership action.

    Identify recurring problems and recommend workflow improvements to reduce preventable denials and payment delays.



Qualifications:



Required



    High school diploma or equivalent.

    At least two years of experience in healthcare credentialing, provider enrollment, or medical billing, with hands-on experience in both credentialing and claims follow-up.

    Working knowledge of insurance eligibility, prior authorizations, claims submission, remittance advice, and denial resolution.

    Familiarity with CAQH, payer portals, electronic health record or practice management systems, clearinghouses, and Excel.

    Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage deadlines, maintain accurate records, and communicate clearly with payers and internal teams.



Preferred:



    Experience billing for outpatient mental health, substance use disorder treatment, applied behavior analysis (ABA), or other behavioral health services.

    Experience with New Jersey and Pennsylvania Medicaid, managed care organizations, or commercial insurance plans.

    Experience enrolling individual providers and group practices across multiple locations.

    A relevant credential such as Certified Provider Credentialing Specialist (CPCS) or Certified Professional Biller (CPB).

Experience estimating underground utilities, excavation, heavy civil construction, or site-development work.



The ability to read civil plans, profiles, details, specifications, geotechnical reports, and bid documents.



Experience completing takeoffs for pipe, structures, excavation, bedding, backfill, import, export, asphalt, concrete, and related work.



An understanding of labor production, equipment production, crew composition, trucking cycles, material waste, and project scheduling.



Strong mathematical and spreadsheet skills.



Strong attention to detail and organizational abilities.

The ability to work independently and remain productive in a remote environment.



Strong written English skills.



The ability to follow estimating systems, pricing policies, and review procedures.



Experience with municipal, government, or prevailing-wage projects is preferred.



A college degree is helpful but is not required if the candidate has strong construction estimating experience.



The estimator needs to:



Complete a high volume of qualified estimates.

The estimator must consistently locate, organize, and complete appropriate bidding opportunities while meeting every assigned deadline.



Produce accurate and complete estimates.

Every estimate must include the necessary labor, equipment, materials, trucking, subcontractors, permits, risk, overhead, and profit. Speed is important, but estimates cannot be rushed at the expense of accuracy.

Finding lowest price on material from our vendors. All material must come from the same place, but lowest overall.



Provide estimates to owner for approval.

Every estimate must be clearly organized and sent to the owner with enough time for review and corrections before the bid deadline. No bid may be submitted externally without the owner’s approval.





Success will be measured through:



Number of qualified estimates completed each day, week, and month.

Quality and organization of estimate files.



Amount of review or correction required before approval.

Comparison of estimated costs and production rates with actual project results.



Reduction in missed items and estimating errors.



Consistent submission of an accurate end-of-day report.



Responsiveness to management’s questions and revision requests.



Ability to manage multiple estimates and deadlines simultaneously.



Reliability, productivity, confidentiality, and accountability while working remotely.



The estimator’s goal is to create a steady pipeline of accurate, well-organized bids for owner to review and approve. A successful employee will increase bidding capacity without sacrificing accuracy or exposing the company to unnecessary financial risk.

title: USA CPA (Certified Public Accountant) - Financial Specialist
description:
Position Summary



ASun Star is seeking an experienced Finance Specialist with an active U.S. CPA license to strengthen financial oversight, ensure accurate financial reporting, and support responsible organizational growth. This position requires demonstrated experience auditing financial statements and payroll, identifying discrepancies, and improving financial controls.



The Finance Specialist will work closely with executive leadership, operations, human resources, and billing to oversee financial accuracy across ASun Star’s programs and locations. The ideal candidate is analytical, thorough, and comfortable investigating transactions, resolving accounting issues, and presenting clear findings and recommendations. Experience with US tax law a plus. 



Essential Responsibilities



Financial Accounting and Reporting

- Maintain and review the general ledger, account reconciliations, journal entries, and supporting documentation.

- Prepare and analyze monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements, including balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow reports.

- Manage month-end and year-end closing activities to ensure timely, accurate reporting.

- Review bank and credit card transactions, expense classifications, and allocations across entities, programs, departments, and locations.

- Monitor accounts payable, accounts receivable, outstanding balances, and cash flow.

- Develop budgets, forecasts, and variance reports; explain significant differences and recommend corrective actions.

Financial Auditing and Internal Controls

- Conduct internal financial reviews and audits to verify the accuracy, completeness, and support for financial transactions.

- Examine financial statements, bank records, invoices, expense reports, and other supporting records to identify discrepancies, duplicate payments, unsupported expenses, or unusual activity.

- Assess internal controls, approval procedures, and segregation of duties; recommend practical improvements.

- Document findings, communicate concerns promptly, and track corrective actions through resolution.

- Coordinate with external auditors, tax professionals, and other authorized reviewers; prepare schedules and supporting documentation.

- Maintain organized financial records and audit trails.

Payroll Review and Auditing

- Audit payroll for accuracy, including employee compensation, hours worked, overtime, paid leave, deductions, benefits, reimbursements, and employer contributions.

- Reconcile payroll registers to timekeeping records, approved compensation, bank activity, and general ledger accounts.

- Verify that new hires, terminations, pay changes, and payroll adjustments are properly authorized and accurately processed.

- Review payroll tax filings and payments with the payroll provider and resolve discrepancies.

- Confirm accurate allocation of payroll expenses across programs, departments, funding sources, and locations.

- Investigate payroll errors, duplicate payments, unauthorized changes, and timekeeping inconsistencies.

- Collaborate with HR and operations to resolve payroll concerns and improve payroll procedures.

Organizational Support and Compliance

- Support financial reporting requirements associated with contracts, grants, insurance reimbursements, and other funding arrangements.

- Coordinate tax preparation and required financial filings with external professionals.

- Develop and update accounting, expense reimbursement, purchasing, and payroll procedures.

- Provide leadership with clear financial summaries, emerging concerns, and actionable recommendations.

- Protect confidential employee, organizational, and financial information.



Required Qualifications

- Active CPA license issued by a U.S. state or jurisdiction, in good standing.

- Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or a closely related field.

- At least five years of progressively responsible accounting or finance experience.

- Demonstrated experience auditing financial statements, accounting records, and payroll.

- Strong knowledge of U.S. generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP), financial reporting, reconciliations, and internal controls.

- Working knowledge of U.S. payroll processes, payroll taxes, and multistate payroll considerations.

- Experience with accounting software, payroll platforms, and timekeeping systems.

- Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and the ability to analyze large transaction datasets.

- Ability to independently investigate discrepancies, document conclusions, and communicate findings clearly.

- Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and consistent follow-through.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in behavioral health, healthcare, or human services organizations.

- Experience with organizations operating across multiple programs, locations, or legal entities.

- Familiarity with New Jersey and Pennsylvania payroll and financial operations.

- Experience reviewing Medicaid-funded program revenue, insurance payments, grants, or government contracts.

- Experience with QuickBooks, third-party payroll providers, and timekeeping platforms such as Hubstaff.

- Public accounting or external audit experience.

Performance Expectations



Success in this role includes accurate and timely financial reporting, completed account and payroll reconciliations, prompt identification and resolution of discrepancies, well-supported expense allocations, and documented improvements to financial controls.



About ASun Star



ASun Star provides behavioral health, developmental, and community-based services to children, adults, and families. Guided by our mission, “Helping People, Changing Lives!!”, we are committed to compassionate services, operational accountability, and responsible stewardship of the resources that support our communities.

title: JerseyBird Long Form Documentary Editor
description:
JerseyBird is one of the most followed teamwear brands in the world. We design custom kits for clubs and schools, and we make JerseyBird on Tour, a documentary series on YouTube: 50 states, 50 stops, 50 stories. In each episode we travel to a team we made kits for and tell the story of the program, the people and the town.



Here is episode one: 



That episode is where we started, not where we are going. We love the animations in it and we want more of that. The pacing and polish are what we believe can be improved, and the next episodes have to be a clear level above it.



We are hiring one long-form documentary editor to own these episodes from raw footage to the final upload-ready file. This is not a role for a short-form editor. We need two things in one person:



1. A real filmmaker. You understand story, pacing, tension and emotion, and you have the hard skills to finish a film: edit, color, sound.



2. AI forward. The animations in episode one were built with an AI-assisted After Effects workflow. You already use AI tools in your motion graphics and editing, and you keep finding new ones. AI makes your work faster and better. It does not replace your taste.



THE WORK



- One episode a month, 30 to 60 minutes each, plus other JerseyBird documentaries as the show grows.



- You receive organized footage, a full script with clip IDs and timestamps, transcripts of every clip, recorded voiceover and reference material.



- You deliver the finished episode. That means all of it:

  - Story edit: pacing, structure, tension, emotion. The script is the backbone, and you make it work on screen.

  - Motion graphics and animation: title cards, name lower thirds, location tags, animated travel maps, player cards and squad screens, on-screen breakdowns with circles and arrows.

  - Captions in one consistent style from start to finish.

  - Color correction and grade.

  - Sound design, music edit and final mix.



- Every graphic is built new for each episode. Nothing is lifted from an old video.



PAY

- $30 USD per finished minute of the approved final episode. A 40 minute episode pays $1,200.

- Two rounds of revisions are included in the rate.

- Paid per episode on approval.

- A retention bonus on top of the rate when an episode beats our audience retention target on YouTube.



REQUIREMENTS

- At least 2 long-form documentaries (15 minutes or longer) that you edited yourself.

- Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects. This is required. You deliver the final file and the full project with organized media.

- Strong motion graphics and animation skills, with AI tools as part of how you work. You build the graphics yourself.

- Color and audio finishing skills.

- A computer and internet connection that can handle large 4K projects.

- Clear written English. You read a detailed script and follow it, and you speak up when something on the page does not work on screen.

- You hit deadlines and you check your own work. No black frames, no missing lower thirds, no unfinished endings in a cut you send us.

- Sports documentary experience is a plus. A love of soccer is a bigger one.



HOW TO APPLY

Put the words "Fifty stops" in the subject line so we know you read this. Then send:

1. Links to 2 or 3 long-form documentaries (15 minutes or longer) you edited.

2. For each one, exactly what you did yourself: edit, graphics, color, sound. If someone else did part of it, say so.

3. Watch episode one and tell us two things you would change to take it up a level.

4. The AI tools you use today and one example of work you made with them (a link or a short clip).

5. Your usual turnaround for a 30 minute documentary.



The strongest applicants get a paid test: a 2 to 3 minute sequence cut from our real footage, with graphics. The hire is made from that test.



Applications without long-form samples will not be read.

title: : Senior Local SEO Strategist (Google Maps & Search) – Full Time, Remote
description:
IL Webdesign is a website development and marketing agency serving medical spas, wellness clinics, telehealth practices, and local service businesses. We build and manage WordPress websites and run SEO for clients who count on us to bring in real patients and customers.



**About the Role**

We're looking for a dedicated, senior-level SEO Strategist who truly understands local search. You'll take ownership of client accounts, including clients who follow SEO best practices but still aren't ranking. Your job is to find out why, build a clear plan to fix it, and work with our team to put that plan in place.



This role is for someone who digs into the research, thinks critically, and brings ideas to the table, not someone who just checks boxes.



**What You'll Do**



- Learn each client's business inside and out: their website, Google Business Profile, services, service area, and competitors

- Research the keywords real patients and customers actually search

- Check rankings on Google Maps and Google Search each month and report where each client stands

- Diagnose why a client isn't ranking or is dropping, including technical, content, Google Business Profile, review, link, and competitor issues

- Build clear 90-day action plans and walk our team through them

- Optimize Google Business Profiles to improve Google Maps (Local 3-Pack) rankings

- Guide on-page SEO, location pages, internal linking, and schema

- Stay current on SEO changes, including Google AI Overviews, and suggest new ways to help our clients grow



**What We're Looking For**

- Fluent in English (Speaking & Reading)

- 5+ years of hands-on SEO experience, with a strong focus on local SEO

- Proven results moving clients into the Google Maps top 3 and onto page 1 of Google Search (please share examples)

- Deep knowledge of Google Business Profile optimization

- Strong research skills. You use AI tools to work faster but never as a replacement for your own research and judgment

- Experience with Google Search Console, Google Analytics, and tools like Ahrefs, Semrush, BrightLocal, or Local Falcon

- Clear written English and the ability to explain problems and plans simply

- Self-motivated, organized, and proactive. You spot problems before we ask

- WordPress experience is a strong plus



**What We Don't Want**



- Ranking "guarantees"

- Spammy shortcuts like link wheels, mass indexing tools, or auto-generated content

- Generic audits that aren't specific to the client



**How to Apply**

Serious applicants only. Please send:



- Your resume

- A short note (3 to 5 sentences) about a local client you helped rank, what was holding them back, and what you did to fix it. Screenshots or results are a plus if you can share them.



Applications without the note will not be reviewed.

title: Freight Dispatcher — U.S. Trucking (Experience Required, Full-Time, Long-Term)
description:
HOW TO APPLY: Please read before applying.

To apply, complete BOTH steps. Applications missing either step will not be reviewed.

Step 1—Send your resume and answer in your own words: Which carriers or brokerages have you dispatched for, and how many trucks?

Step 2—Record a Loom video (3 minutes maximum).

Record yourself as if you are on the phone with one of our drivers. He has arrived at a rail facility to pick up a load. The kiosk says there is no waybill for his load, so he cannot get in the gate. He has been waiting 40 minutes, and he is frustrated.

Talk through how you would handle that call and what you would do next.

Do not script it. We want to hear how you actually think.

Include your Loom link with your application.

About us

WH Trucking is a U.S.-based asset carrier operating out of Georgia. We run dedicated contract freight, intermodal/rail moves, and spot loads. We are a small team that moves fast, and you will work directly with the owner.

We are hiring four dispatchers to build out 24/7 coverage. This is a long-term position with room to grow as we add trucks.

A note on the schedule: our night shift runs from 6:00 PM to 6:00 AM U.S. Eastern, which is approximately 6:00 AM to 6:00 PM Philippine time. If you are assigned nights, you will be working normal daytime hours locally.

What you'll do:

1.	Coordinate daily load assignments and driver schedules.

2.	Communicate with drivers throughout your shift on pickups, deliveries, and delays.

3.	Manage a dedicated contract account with recurring weekly loads.

4.	Handle rail/intermodal pickups and in-gate coordination.

5.	Track loads from pickup through delivery; flag problems before they escalate.

6.	Collect and file BOLs, PODs, and rate confirmations.

7.	Maintain dispatch trackers and operational spreadsheets

8.	Escalate facility, appointment, and detention issues

9.	Support spot load bidding and rate research.

10.	Hand off cleanly to the incoming dispatcher at shift change.



Required

1.	*** A MUST: Proficient in Google Workspace (Sheets, Gmail, Drive, Docs) *** An assessment will be given; please do not apply if you’re not proficient in this area.

2.	Prior U.S. freight dispatching experience. This is not negotiable. In your application, list the carriers or brokerages you dispatched for, along with the fleet size.

3.	Strong written and spoken English skills; you will speak with U.S. drivers and facility staff every shift.

4.	Confident on the phone, including with frustrated drivers

5.	Reliable high-speed internet with a backup connection and a plan for power outages

6.	Quiet, dedicated workspace

7.	Self-starter who solves problems rather than forwarding them

8.	Nice to have—we will train.

9.	Amazon Relay experience

10.	Intermodal/rail experience (CSX, BNSF)

11.	Any TMS experience

12.	FMCSA compliance familiarity

13.	Small-fleet dispatch experience (as opposed to large carrier)



Availability requirements

This is a 12-hour shift position on a rotating schedule averaging 42 hours per week, with every other weekend off. Dispatch is a live-coverage role. Trucks, drivers, and facilities do not wait, and no one else can cover your desk while you are away from it. 

This position requires:

1.	Full availability for your entire 12-hour shift, without interruption

2.	A dedicated workspace separate from household activity

3.	Reliable internet plus a backup connection and a power outage plan

4.	No other concurrent job or client work during your shift

5.	Consistent attendance; coverage gaps directly affect our customer accounts.

6.	Willingness to work either day or night rotation as assigned



Please be honest with yourself about this before applying. If your current situation does not allow you to be at your desk and responsive for a full 12-hour block, this role will not be a good fit, and we would rather you apply for something that better suits your schedule.

HOW TO APPLY

To apply, complete BOTH steps. Applications missing either step will not be reviewed.

Step 1—Send your resume and answer in your own words: Which carriers or brokerages have you dispatched for, and how many trucks?

Step 2—Record a Loom video (3 minutes maximum).

Record yourself as if you are on the phone with one of our drivers. He has arrived at a rail facility to pick up a load. The kiosk says there is no waybill for his load, so he cannot get in the gate. He has been waiting 40 minutes, and he is frustrated.

Talk through how you would handle that call and what you would do next.

Include your Loom link with your application.

title: Digital Marketing & Operations Virtual Assistant
description:
Approximately 8 hours per week

Long-term opportunity



I'm looking for a highly dependable, detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to help with digital marketing and communications work for several nonprofit/ministry-related projects in the United States.



This is not primarily a general administrative VA position. Much of the initial work involves producing
 campaigns and moving projects through established digital systems.



// What you'll be doing //



Your initial responsibilities will include:



- Monitoring and working from assigned tasks in Asana



- Building and formatting
 campaigns in platforms such as ActiveCampaign and iContact (we provide graphics)



- Finding and adapting previous
 campaigns for current events/projects



- Gathering graphics and other assets from Asana and shared resources



- Using AI tools such as ChatGPT to help update, revise, proofread and QA content



- Working with contact lists and databases



- Exporting/importing contact data when necessary



- Working with spreadsheets (usually contact data filtering)



- Occasionally assisting with Zapier workflows



- Sending campaigns for review and approval



- Checking dates, links, graphics, audiences and other details before anything is sent



You do not need previous experience with every platform we use, I care more about your ability to learn software quickly and solve problems independently. But knowing your experience will help (see below).



// The person I'm looking for //



You should be:



- Extremely detail-oriented



- Reliable and consistent



- Comfortable learning unfamiliar software



- Strong in written English



- Well versed with AI tools such as ChatGPT



- Able to follow established processes



- Willing to ask questions when something genuinely needs clarification



- Able to figure out routine problems without constantly asking for instructions



- Comfortable handling repetitive work accurately



- Interested in a long-term working relationship



// Technical Experience //



Previous experience with
 marketing platforms and digital marketing workflows is strongly preferred.



Experience with the following platforms is particularly valuable:



- ActiveCampaign — high priority



- Asana — high priority



- iContact — highly desirable



- ChatGPT or other AI tools — highly desirable



- Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel



- Zapier



- Canva



- CRM and contact database systems



You do not need experience with every platform listed. However, preference will be given to candidates who already have hands-on experience with several of these tools, particularly ActiveCampaign and Asana.



You should also demonstrate an ability to learn unfamiliar software quickly and independently.



// Platform Experience — Application Questions //



***For each of the platforms listed above, please indicate your level of experience



> None: I have never used it.



> Basic: I have used it occasionally.



> Intermediate: I can perform routine tasks independently.



> Advanced: I am highly proficient and can troubleshoot problems independently.



For any
 marketing platforms you have used, please briefly describe the types of campaigns, contact management, automations, or other responsibilities you have personally handled.



Please include portfolio examples or screenshots of previous
 marketing work, where available and permitted.

----



// Hours //



Approximately 8 hours per week initially.



During the first few weeks, we'll spend some time working together so you can learn my systems and workflows. I will often demonstrate a task by screen sharing or recording the process. As you become comfortable, you'll take ownership of those tasks.



There may be an opportunity for additional hours and responsibilities in the future.



// Compensation // 



$6–$9 USD per hour, depending on experience and demonstrated proficiency with the platforms listed. Higher compensation may be considered for an exceptional candidate. Opportunities for increased hours, responsibilities and compensation as our working relationship develops.



How to apply



Please send:



1. A short introduction about yourself.



2. Your current work situation and weekly availability.



3. Your experience with the platforms mentioned above



4. Your experience with Asana or similar project-management software.



5. Which AI tools you currently use and one specific example of how you've used AI to make your work better or faster.



6. Your requested hourly rate.



Also answer this question:



You are preparing an
 campaign and notice that the event date in Asana is different from the date shown on the event registration page. What would you do?



Please begin your application with the words:



“YELLOW JELLY BEAN”



Applications that do not include those words will not be considered.



Finalists will be invited to complete a short paid skills assessment before a hiring decision is made.

title: eBay Lister with Pricing Research Experience (Part-Time, 20 Hours a Week, Long-Term)
description:
We are a small US-based seller and we need one experienced eBay lister to take over our listings.



I'm looking to make hiring decision within a few days. Need asap. 



Here is how it works. We take the photos and give every item a SKU number. We send you the photos, the SKU, and notes on condition, weight and size. You do the rest.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Research each item and find out what it is really selling for (sold listings, not asking prices)

- Set the price

- Write the title with the right keywords

- Pick the right category and fill in all the item specifics

- Write a short, honest description

- Enter the SKU on every listing so we can find the item when it sells

- Keep a simple spreadsheet of what you listed and the price you set



We sell clothes, media items, and tools to list a few.



WHAT WE NEED FROM YOU

- At least 6 moths of real eBay listing experience. This is a must.

- You know how to price used items from sold comps

- Good written English and careful spelling

- A reliable computer and internet connection

- You follow instructions and ask when something is not clear



HOURS AND PAY

- About 20 hours a week. You choose your own hours. There is no set shift.

- We have a big backlog right now, so extra hours are available in the first weeks if you want them. Provided we can keep up with photos. After that it settles into steady part-time work.

- $4 per hour to start. 

- Paid every week.

- This is a long-term job. We want one person we can keep.

- Paid weekly via Wise. We can also pay Paypal, Wise is just faster usually.



HOW TO APPLY

Put the words "SOLD COMPS" in the subject line of your message so we know you read this. Attach resume. Then answer these questions: Send to this
 - 



1. How long have you been listing on eBay, and what kinds of items?

2. You have a used item and you cannot find an exact match on eBay. How do you d
 the price?

3. About how many listings can you finish in one hour, including research?

4. What hours can you work, and when can you start?



The best applicants will get a short PAID test: 10 items to research, set price, and write a description.

title: Part-Time Commercial Estimator - Drywall, Metal Framing & Paint (US Tenant Improvements)
description:
SCHEDULE: Part-time, 20 hrs/week. Monday-Friday, 5:00am-9:00am US Mountain Time (8:00pm-12:00am Philippine time).

PAY: Up to $7/hr depending on experience.



ABOUT US

We are a Utah subcontractor doing interior metal stud framing, drywall, and paint, mostly on commercial tenant improvement (TI) projects under 15,000 SF, plus some residential. We need an estimator who produces accurate quantity takeoffs and organized bid packages so we can bid more work.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Review plans, specifications (especially Division 09), finish schedules, reflected ceiling plans, and addenda

- Take off metal stud framing (LF by wall type and height), gypsum board (SF by type and layers, including fire-rated and moisture-resistant board), ceilings, soffits, insulation, and paint (SF by surface and coating system)

- Count doors, frames, openings, corners, and blocking/backing locations

- Enter quantities into our estimate template. We provide material pricing from our suppliers and labor rates from our subs.

- Write scope inclusions, exclusions, assumptions, and questions (RFIs) for every bid

- Flag scope gaps, unclear details, and risks

- Send an end-of-shift update: bids completed, bids in progress, open questions, upcoming deadlines



REQUIREMENTS

- 3+ years estimating US commercial interiors: drywall, metal stud framing, and paint (5+ years preferred)

- Proficient in Bluebeam Revu, PlanSwift, STACK, or similar takeoff software. You must have your own access for the paid skills test.

- On-Screen Takeoff / Quick Bid experience is a strong plus

- Understands US wall assemblies, UL fire-rated assemblies, STC sound walls, shaft walls, and drywall finish levels (0-5)

- Clear written and spoken English. We use Zoom, Slack, and
.

- Backup power AND backup internet (required)

- Computer with 16GB+ RAM and two monitors

- Able to keep plans, pricing, and company information confidential



HIRING PROCESS

1. Application review

2. 20-minute Zoom interview (you will share your screen and walk through a past takeoff)

3. Paid skills test on a real past project

4. 30-day paid trial



HOW TO APPLY

Start your application with the words "TI ESTIMATOR" and answer these 3 questions:

1. Which takeoff software do you use, and about how many US commercial projects have you estimated in it?

2. A corridor wall is 3-5/8" metal studs, 1-hour rated, 10 ft high, 120 LF long, with no finish level specified. What quantities would you take off, and what would you ask before bidding?

3. Describe one scope gap you caught on a past bid that would have cost the contractor money.



Applications without "TI ESTIMATOR" and the answers to all 3 questions will not be reviewed.

title: On-Camera Brand Spokesperson & Content Creator (US Brand – Remote)
description:
We are a US-based business looking for an energetic, charismatic, and reliable On-Camera Brand Spokesperson & Content Creator based in the Philippines.

You will be the face and voice of our brand across social media (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and
) and marketing campaigns. Your main responsibility will be filming yourself speaking directly to the camera—educating our audience about our services, demonstrating our products, and delivering engaging, conversational videos tailored to a US audience.



What You Will Do

• Film 15-to-60-second vertical and horizontal videos talking about our products, services, and customer benefits.

• Deliver scripts in a natural, conversational, and engaging tone (never sounding stiff or overly "salesy").

• Follow creative briefs and hooks provided by our team, while bringing your own personality and energy to the camera.

• Film in a clean, well-lit, quiet indoor environment with a modern background.

• Deliver raw or lightly edited high-resolution video files (1080p or 4K) on schedule.



Requirements

• Spoken English: Exceptional, fluent spoken English with a neutral or North American accent and natural pacing.

• On-Camera Presence: Confident, expressive, and comfortable talking to a lens as if speaking to a friend.

• Equipment & Setup:

• Good lighting (ring light, softbox, or bright natural window light).

• Clear audio (lapel/lavalier mic or dedicated podcast/USB mic—no echo or background street noise).

title: Inbound Phone Setter – US Patients (Native-Level English for Fast Call-Backs)
description:
