Pay: $7 USD/hour + $5 bonus for every lead you set who becomes a patient



About us

We're a physician-led knee clinic in Ontario, Canada. Patients from the US contact us about a knee treatment. 



The job

When a patient fills out our form, you call them back within 30 seconds. You:

1. Greet them warmly, ask a short set of qualifying questions (script provided) and hand over to closer or schedule for the closer.



You must have

1. Near-native US English. 

2. A warm, patient, calm voice. Our callers are older and sometimes hard of hearing.

3. Speed: you answer and call back within seconds, all shift long.

4. A quiet room, a quality headset, fast internet plus a backup connection.

5. Comfortable with a CRM and a softphone (we use HubSpot/Pipedrive and Quo; training provided).



Growth

This role leads to a closer position with a higher bonus structure for the right person.



How to apply (applications without both recordings won't be reviewed)

1. Record yourself reading this script as a voice memo:

"Hi, this is [your name] from Landmark Knee. You just asked about our knee treatment. I'd love to find out if you'd be a good candidate. Do you mind if I ask your name first? … Great. And how long has your knee been bothering you? Have you had any injections for it before?"

2. Record a second voice memo, no script, answering this caller: "Is this a scam? Why would I go to Canada for this?"

3. Write "KNEE" as the first word of your application, and tell us your available hours in US Eastern time.

title: Operations Support Specialist
description:
Remote | Full-Time | Long-Term Opportunity | Philippines



About Realty Hub



Realty Hub is an established U.S. real estate brokerage operating across Florida, Georgia, and Alabama.



Our remote operations team supports real estate agents through documented procedures, internal systems, and a centralized knowledge base. We focus on providing accurate, dependable support while continuously improving how our business operates.



We’re looking for a reliable, detail-oriented professional who enjoys learning, researching information, solving problems, and taking ownership of their work.



Prior real estate experience is not required. What matters most is your ability to learn, follow procedures accurately, think independently, and apply what you’ve learned.



We’re seeking someone interested in building a long-term professional relationship with our company.



About the Role

As an Operations Support Specialist, your initial responsibilities will focus on live chat support, routine agent inquiries, and basic operational assistance.



You’ll learn to navigate our internal resources, locate accurate information, assist agents, and recognize when a question requires additional review or escalation.



As you demonstrate proficiency, you may gradually take on additional operational responsibilities.



We’re not looking for someone who simply memorizes answers. We’re looking for someone who can research, understand, verify, and apply information independently.



Primary Responsibilities



Agent Support & Live Chat

Respond to agent inquiries through live chat and other assigned support channels.

Research answers using standard operating procedures (SOPs), company policies, and internal resources.

Communicate clearly, accurately, and professionally.

Identify situations requiring additional review or escalation.

Document inquiries and complete necessary follow-ups.



Operational Support

Follow established procedures for assigned administrative tasks.

Review information and documents for completeness and accuracy.

Maintain accurate records, trackers, and task statuses.

Verify required information before completing assigned workflows.

Track pending tasks and follow through without repeated reminders.

Additional Responsibilities as You Develop



Depending on your progress, you may gradually learn:



Agent onboarding and activation workflows.

License transfers and listing-related administrative tasks.

Basic transaction document review.

Additional operational systems and procedures.

SOP updates and knowledge base improvements.

Advanced responsibilities are introduced gradually, based on demonstrated proficiency and operational needs.



How We Work

We don’t expect you to know every answer or memorize every procedure.



We do expect you to:



Research before asking: Consult available documentation and resources before seeking assistance.

Understand, not just memorize: Learn why procedures exist so you can apply them to different situations.

Follow through: Track unfinished tasks and ensure nothing is overlooked.

Verify information: Prioritize accuracy over speed.

Use sound judgment: Recognize when to investigate further and when to escalate.

Learn from feedback: Apply corrections and avoid repeating preventable mistakes.

Take ownership: Be accountable for your responsibilities and communicate proactively.

Asking questions is encouraged. We value thoughtful questions that demonstrate preparation, effort, and a willingness to learn.



Training & Professional Development

We provide structured onboarding and ongoing opportunities to develop your professional skills.



Your initial training will include:

Guided navigation of our SOPs and support resources.

Introduction to internal systems and workflows.

Practical exercises and simulated agent inquiries.

Supervised live chat and operational tasks.

Regular feedback and progress reviews.

Training begins with a limited number of responsibilities. As your accuracy, confidence, and independence improve, additional tasks may be introduced.



We evaluate progress based on your ability to perform assigned work correctly, consistently, and with decreasing supervision—not simply how quickly you complete training.



What Success Looks Like



First 30 Days

Become comfortable navigating our SOPs and support resources.

Demonstrate effective research and reading comprehension.

Complete introductory training and practical exercises.

Begin handling selected routine inquiries and tasks with appropriate supervision.

Demonstrate attention to detail, accountability, and willingness to learn.



Days 31–60

Handle assigned routine tasks with increasing independence.

Consistently track pending work and complete follow-ups.

Apply previously learned procedures to similar situations.

Recognize when an issue requires escalation.

Demonstrate measurable improvement in accuracy and efficiency.



Days 61–90

Independently manage assigned responsibilities with consistent accuracy.

Handle routine agent inquiries confidently.

Maintain reliable task ownership and follow-through.

Demonstrate readiness to learn additional operational workflows.

Progression is based on demonstrated performance and may vary depending on assigned responsibilities.



Compensation & Benefits

Starting rate: $5.00 USD per hour, based on a 40-hour workweek.



Higher starting compensation may be considered for exceptionally qualified candidates based on demonstrated experience and capabilities.



13th-month pay provided annually in December.

Paid holidays in accordance with company policy.

Three paid wellness days annually, allocated quarterly during the first three quarters.

Structured training and opportunities for continued professional development.

Opportunities to participate in company-sponsored employee retreats, subject to eligibility and company arrangements.

Long-term opportunity with an established U.S. real estate brokerage.

We value the well-being of our team members and believe that professional development, personal wellness, and a supportive work environment contribute to long-term success.



Work Schedule

Full-Time Remote Position — 40 Hours Per Week

Regular work schedule: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time.

Initial training: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time, for approximately two weeks.

Because the position follows U.S. Eastern Time, working hours in the Philippines will generally be:

9:00 PM–5:00 AM Philippine Time during U.S. daylight saving time.

10:00 PM–6:00 AM Philippine Time during U.S. standard time.



Applicants must be comfortable maintaining this overnight schedule on a long-term basis.



Reliable availability during assigned working hours is essential.



Required Qualifications

Excellent written and spoken English.

Strong reading comprehension and attention to detail.

Ability to research, understand, and apply unfamiliar information.

Strong organizational and follow-through skills.

Comfortable navigating websites, documentation, and multiple software systems.

Ability to work independently while following established procedures.

Good judgment, professionalism, and accountability.

Willingness to receive feedback and continuously improve.

Reliable availability during assigned working hours.

Previous experience in customer support, administrative operations, or process-driven work is helpful but not required.



We place greater importance on demonstrated ability, reliability, and willingness to learn than on job titles or years of experience alone.



Equipment & Connectivity Requirements



Reliable computer suitable for multitasking.

Stable primary internet connection.

Backup internet connection.

Reliable backup power arrangement for internet and computer equipment.

Quiet, professional workspace.

Headset suitable for voice communication.

Second monitor recommended but not required.

Applicants should be prepared to explain their backup arrangements and how they would maintain availability during internet or power interruptions.



How to Apply

Please include the following information in your application:



Brief introduction and relevant work experience.

Expected hourly rate in USD.

Current location in the Philippines.

Primary internet provider and recently tested connection speed.

Backup internet solution.

Backup power arrangement.

Computer and equipment specifications.

Confirmation that you can work the required U.S. Eastern Time schedule on a long-term basis.



Please also answer the following two questions using specific examples from your own experience.



Question 1 — Independent Problem-Solving



Describe a time you encountered a work-related problem you didn’t know how to solve. What steps did you take, what resources did you use, and what was the outcome?



Question 2 — Accountability & Follow-Through



Tell us about a time you overlooked a task or made a mistake at work. How did you address it, and what did you change to prevent it from happening again?



We value specific, thoughtful answers that reflect your actual experience.



Our Selection Process

Shortlisted applicants may be invited to complete a practical assessment involving research, reading comprehension, resource navigation, problem-solving, and task organization.



This assessment is designed to evaluate how you approach unfamiliar situations, locate information, and apply instructions accurately.



Finalists will be invited to an interview.



Important Application Instructions

Please complete all requested information and answer both application questions.



Incomplete applications may not be considered.



We value clear communication, careful reading, genuine effort, and professionalism throughout the application process.



We’re looking for someone who wants to learn, contribute, and grow with Realty Hub over the long term.

title: Social Media Manager & Strategy
description:
We are hiring a Content Strategist / Social Media Manager to plan, produce, and execute content across Instagram,
, LinkedIn, and TikTok for an established personal brand in the video marketing and monetization space.



This is a hybrid role. You will own the content planning process — building monthly plans, writing hooks, scripting videos, and tracking trends — AND you will execute that plan day to day: scheduling, publishing, managing the content calendar, and monitoring performance.



Content direction and final approval come from Keenya, but you are the person who turns her vision into a running system that never misses a beat.



You will have room to bring your own instincts to formatting, execution, and idea generation.



But this is not a role where you are setting the brand's overall strategic direction from scratch.





About the Brand



Keenya Kelly is a video marketing and monetization strategist with a large established audience across TikTok, Instagram, LinkedIn, and
. We teach entrepreneurs how to grow through short vertical video and turn their content into consistent income.



We are a systems-driven team that moves fast, especially during launch periods, and we need someone who can keep pace without needing constant hand-holding.



What This Role Actually Is



You are the engine that keeps content moving every day — from the planning stage all the way through to publishing. You will build the content plans, write the hooks and captions, track what is trending, and then bring all of that to life across platforms on schedule.



You bring enough of your own judgment to catch what is working, flag what is not, and suggest adjustments in real time.



We are not looking for someone who only follows instructions with no instincts of their own.



We want someone with a genuine feel for short vertical video who can plan strategically, execute at a high level, and speak up when something is not landing.



What We Are Looking For



1. You can plan content that actually drives results

You build monthly content plans that include filming briefs, on-screen text hooks, talking points or scripts, captions, and platform-specific variations for TikTok, Instagram,
, and LinkedIn.



Every piece aligns with our content pillars, audience stage, and sales goals so each video moves people toward a clear next step.



2. You have a real feel for short vertical video

You understand pacing, hooks, text overlay timing, and what makes a piece of content stop the scroll.



You track current trends, audios, and formats on TikTok and Instagram and turn them into content ideas that fit our brand — not just follow trends blindly.



3. You can execute at volume, reliably

You manage content calendars, schedule and publish across multiple platforms, and keep everything organized without things falling through the cracks — especially during launch periods when volume increases.



You keep a clean, organized tracker so the team always knows what is approved, filmed, and scheduled.



4. You write hooks that stop the scroll and captions that sound human

You write on-screen text hooks that make people stop scrolling. Your captions feel like a real conversation, not a sales pitch.



You have a natural sense of voice and can write in a style that sounds like the person posting — not like generic marketing copy.



5. You are proactive, not just responsive

You flag what is underperforming, suggest small tweaks, and bring ideas to the table — without needing to own the entire strategic direction.



You know the difference between "I have a suggestion" and "I am going to change the plan."



6. You are highly organized and communicative

You meet deadlines without being chased, you do not go quiet when things get busy, and you are comfortable working inside an established system with clear processes.



You submit plans on a set schedule and revise them quickly based on feedback.



7. You are comfortable working under direction from the brand owner

This role reports into content direction set by Keenya. You should want that structure, not resent it.



You take direction well and give thoughtful input without needing to own every decision.



What This Role Involves



Planning

Building monthly content plans with filming briefs, on-screen text hooks, talking points or scripts, captions, and platform-specific variations

Tracking current trends, audios, and formats on TikTok and Instagram and turning them into on-brand content ideas

Aligning every piece with content pillars, audience stage, and sales goals

Submitting plans on a set schedule and revising quickly based on feedback

Execution

Publishing and scheduling content across Instagram,
, LinkedIn, and TikTok

Managing and maintaining the content calendar

Executing hooks, scripts, captions, and CTAs as directed, with room for your own polish on formatting and delivery

Keeping content organized in our shared systems (Google Workspace, ManyChat, Metricool)

Performance and Communication

Monitoring performance day to day and flagging what is working or not

Adapting quickly and staying responsive during active launches, live challenges, webinars, and campaigns

Communicating proactively — daily check-ins during active periods



How to Apply



Start your application message with the word TIKTOK to confirm you have read the full posting.



Then answer the screening questions below and attach your resume and two or three examples of content you have planned or created that performed well, with results if you have them.



Your application should also include:



A brief note on your experience executing content across TikTok, Instagram,
, and LinkedIn — what platforms, what volume, what tools you have used

One or two examples of accounts where you handled both planning and execution — what your role was specifically, and what the results looked like

Your availability for a full-time role



Screening Questions



Walk us through a piece of content you planned that turned into sales. What was the hook, the format, the CTA, and the result?

Which TikTok or Instagram trend are you watching right now? Explain why it is working and how you would adapt it for women business owners.

Write a sample on-screen text hook (one line) for a video about why women business owners should stop waiting to feel ready before they start filming. Then give a second hook that uses a contrarian angle.



Our plans are due on a set day each month. Describe a time you met a tight deadline while keeping quality high. How did you prioritize?

How do you keep a content calendar organized when you are managing many pieces at once? What tools or systems do you use?

How do you make sure captions sound like the person who is posting them and not like generic marketing copy?

Tell us about a time you received feedback that changed your approach. How did you respond?

What does a healthy working relationship with a content owner look like to you, and how do you handle it when your ideas are not chosen?

Our team is small and works closely together. What do you enjoy most about collaborating on a creative team?

What is your availability each week, and what time zone are you working in?

description:
Senior Creative Strategist (Philippines)



Salary: USD 10.50 to 14.00 per hour, depending on experience (about USD 1,820 to 2,430 per month, full-time)

Bonus: up to USD 400 per month for winning ads

Hours: PH 13:00 to 22:00, Monday to Friday, all year. In the Netherlands that is 07:00 to 16:00 in summer time (end of March to end of October) and 06:00 to 15:00 in winter time. An afternoon and evening shift, not a graveyard shift. These are fixed working hours: this is not an output-based role with flexible hours.

Type: full-time, remote, long term

Benefits: 13th month bonus (pro rata), paid in the first week of December. HMO allowance of up to $75 per month, starting 4 months after your start date.



ABOUT VIBRIX

Vibrix is a Dutch brand for a healthy indoor climate. Our founder, Remco Lunshof, suffered from allergies and asthma for years. He tested air purifiers from the big brands, was not convinced, and in 2019 started Vibrix in Rijswijk (Netherlands) with one air purifier of his own. Johnny Ma joined as co-owner in 2023 and leads product development.



Today we sell air purifiers (PureFlow), dehumidifiers (DryFlow) and replacement filters to thousands of households through our own webshop, Bol and Amazon. We test every model ourselves before it goes on sale, customers get an answer from a real person every day, and we are rated 4.6 out of 5 on Trustpilot from more than 3,200 reviews. Our products are made by partner factories in China, and we now receive full 40HQ containers every month.



Our mission: healthy air in every home, in every season. We want to grow from the Netherlands and Belgium to more European countries, and over the next 12 to 18 months we are building a team of experienced people, most of them in the Philippines.



See who we are on our website: vibrix . nl (type it without the spaces)



You will work directly with the owners, Remco and Johnny, and with our new Team Lead.



THE ROLE

You own the question: which ads do we make next, and why? You turn customer insights and ad data into new ad concepts, write the briefs, and make sure every test teaches us something.



In your first 90 days you will:

• Review our current ads and customer reviews, and write down what works and what does not.

• Set up a weekly creative testing rhythm: new concepts, clear hypotheses, one report per week.

• Write briefs for UGC creators, designers and video editors, and give feedback until the ad is right.

• Build a library of hooks, angles and winning ads, so the team can see what we learned.



After a year, success looks like this:

• New ad concepts go live every week, each with a clear brief and hypothesis.

• Every test has a result in the weekly report, and the next concepts are based on it.

• We have a set of winning ads per product and per market that we can scale.



WHAT WE ASK

• E-commerce experience in our niche. At least 3 years of proven experience in this role, at one B2C e-commerce brand that sells electrical appliances, consumer electronics or a similar product category online to consumers, with USD 5 to 20M yearly revenue. That is the revenue of your employer itself, not of a client or a parent company. Large corporations, Amazon aggregators, companies with many brands and B2B companies are not what we are looking for.

• At least 3 years as a creative strategist for paid social ads (Meta or TikTok), for e-commerce or consumer brands.

• You have written creative briefs for UGC creators, designers or video editors yourself.

• You use ad data (for example thumbstop, hook rate, CTR, CPA or ROAS) to choose which ads to make next. In the form you share an ad you made, with its numbers.

• Employed, not freelance. You worked in-house or at an agency, not only as a freelancer, VA or on a task basis.

• This is your only job. No other job or clients next to this role. If you have one now, you stop before you start with us.

• Certificate of Employment (COE) from your last two employers. A recommendation letter or a Certificate of Engagement is not a COE. We check your employment with your previous employers ourselves, with your permission.

• SOPs. You write work instructions (SOPs) yourself. In the form you share one you wrote that a team actually used. Remove private details, keep the structure.

• Revenue and team size per employer. In the form you give, for each employer: the official company name, website, your dates, your job title, the yearly revenue of the company itself in USD, and the size of your team.

• At least 15 Mbps download speed, measured on the computer and at the place you will work from. The form asks for the link to your speedtest.net result.

• A laptop with 8 GB RAM and a good headset.



Nice to have: experience with ads for European markets.



We are looking for someone who knows more than we do about ad creative. You learn fast, figure things out yourself and want to grow with the company.



WHAT THIS JOB IS NOT

• Not a graphic designer or video editor role. You plan and brief the ads, others make most of them.

• Not a media buyer role. You work closely with whoever runs the campaigns, but your focus is the creative.

• Not a graveyard shift.

About Jones Media|



Jones Media is a growing wedding photography and videography company serving couples across multiple states throughout the United States.



We are expanding our team and looking for an experienced Digital Marketing & Lead Generation Specialist who can take ownership of our marketing efforts, increase brand awareness, and generate qualified wedding inquiries.

We are looking for a proactive, results-driven marketing professional who can independently develop, execute, manage, and optimize marketing strategies.

 and Instagram advertising campaigns.

description:

A company with a clear system, transparent compensation, and leadership that takes your development seriously. You'll know exactly what's expected, exactly what you'll earn, and exactly how to grow. We want people who stay, improve, and build with us long term.

title: Cold Caller/ Appt Setter (Real Estate / Vacant Land) — Remote
description:
Cold Caller (Real Estate / Vacant Land) — Remote



The Land Pioneer | Hiring 6–10 | Apply: 



Heads up: this listing is long on purpose. We need you to read it. There are instructions buried inside that tell us whether you actually did. Skim and you're out.





Who we are:



The Land Pioneer (
) is a vacant land acquisitions and dispositions business. We buy raw land at a discount, then sell it. Cold calling is the engine of our pipeline — without great callers, nothing else moves.



Who we're looking for:



We're hiring 6–10 cold callers who already know how to sell. We are NOT going to train you on:



How to handle objections:



How to build rapport in the first 15 seconds

What a motivated seller actually sounds like

Why "just thinking about it" isn't a real objection



If you're early in your sales career and looking for someone to teach you scripts and tonality, this isn't the role. We need experienced callers — people who can pick up a phone, navigate a conversation, keep a stranger on the line, and know within two minutes whether the person on the other end is a real lead, a maybe, or a tire-kicker. You should be able to filter hot from cold without us looking over your shoulder.



Must-haves:



Real estate cold calling experience in the US market. Vacant land experience is a major plus and will likely earn you a higher starting rate.



Neutral or American accent with strong English fluency. You should sound like someone a US homeowner would comfortably talk to for ten minutes without feeling like they're on a "sales call."



A proven track record. We will ask for references and metrics — dials per day, contact rates, qualified leads passed, deals sourced.



Recorded calls we can listen to. Non-negotiable. If you don't have them, don't apply. Redact PII where needed, but we want to hear you in action — wins and tough calls both.



Reliable internet, a quality headset, a quiet workspace, and the ability to overlap with US time zones.



Adaptability. Our process evolves. We test scripts, swap list sources, refine criteria. You should welcome that, not resist it.



What you'll be doing:



Calling property owners from lists we provide

Use our software to look at the property features

Provide range offers to the sellers (After training)

Building rapport quickly, finding motivation, qualifying or disqualifying fast

Passing warm, vetted leads to our acquisitions team

Logging clean notes in our CRM

Hitting daily and weekly KPIs on dials, contacts, and qualified leads



Compensation:



Hourly base



Junior callers (less experience but strong fundamentals): $4/hr

Seasoned callers (verifiable track record, especially in land): higher base — we'll discuss based on what you bring



Acquisition bonus:



For Junior Cold Callers: $75 paid as soon as a deal closes on the acquisitions side from a lead you sourced. This applies during probation and continues after.



For Experienced Cold Callers: $150 paid as soon as a deal closes on the acquisitions side from a lead you sourced. This applies during probation and continues after.



After 90 days (post-probation)



You graduate onto our tier-based back-end comp plan. When a deal you sourced closes full cycle — meaning we've bought it AND sold it on the dispositions side — you get paid out of the sales funds when they hit our account. This is where the real money is for our long-term callers. We're not playing games with comp; when we win, you win.





How to apply — read carefully, this IS the filter


 
 with everything below. Missing pieces get your application moved to the trash.



1. Subject line — use this exact format: Cold Caller Application — [Your Name] — [Years of RE Cold Calling Experience]



2. The very first line of your email body must read: I read the whole post — here's my pitch. If this line is missing, you don't make it to the next round. We mean it.



3. Attach or link the following:



Your resume (PDF preferred)



2–3 recorded cold calls. At least one should be a call where you turned a cold or skeptical prospect into a real conversation. Add a one-line note telling us what to listen for.



A Loom video, 3–5 minutes max, introducing yourself and walking us through (a) what you know about the US real estate industry and (b) what you know — or want to learn — about vacant land specifically. Talk to the camera the way you'd talk to a seller. We're evaluating presence, not just content.



4. In the body of the email, answer these three questions briefly:



What's the #1 thing you do in the first 20 seconds of a cold call to keep someone on the line?



Tell us about a deal you sourced that you're proud of — what made the seller motivated, and how did you uncover it?



What's a real estate or land-specific term you've used on a call recently, and how did you use it? (We want to hear you actually speak the language.)



5. At the very bottom of your email, write one sentence about something on 
 that stood out to you. One sentence is enough — we just want to know you looked.





What happens next:



We review applications in the order they come in. If your call recordings and Loom land, we'll set up an interview. If that goes well, you're in — and we move fast. We're aiming to onboard all 6–10 hires within the next few weeks.



We're not the right fit for everyone. But if you're a real cold caller who's tired of being underpaid, micromanaged, or handed scripts you didn't help build — we'd love to hear from you.



Newman The Land Pioneer

title: Customer Support & Compliance Analyst
description:
Position Overview:



This is a full-time, fully remote role for a Customer Support & Compliance Analyst supporting a financial institution that uses cryptocurrency and stablecoins to power its operations. This is a hybrid role, weighted toward compliance.



The majority of your time will be spent reviewing retail applicants from a compliance perspective: verifying identity documentation, requesting additional information, managing resubmissions, conducting customer due diligence and AML screening, and escalating high-risk cases. You'll work closely with the Compliance Manager to refine onboarding workflows and ensure adherence to global AML/CTF standards.



The remainder of your time will be spent on customer support: responding to customer inquiries, resolving issues, and maintaining a high level of customer service. Much of the compliance review work is customer-facing, since it means communicating clearly with applicants about what's needed and why.



About Us:

title: Bookkeeper
description:
About Us

We are a Los Angeles property management company with roughly 170 residential properties

and about thirty owners. Our accounting team keeps payables, receipts, reconciliations, and owner reporting accurate

and on time — all in AppFolio. Owners make decisions from the numbers we produce, so clean books are not a nice-to-

have.



The Role

You own the books. Day-to-day payables and receivables, monthly reconciliations across bank, loan and

credit card accounts, month-end close, journal entries, and the financial reports our owners and accountant

rely on. This is not data entry with a close attached — we want someone who can tell us why a number

moved, not just that it did.



What You'll Do

General accounting and bookkeeping

● Record daily transactions and maintain an accurate general ledger in AppFolio.

● Prepare and post journal entries, accruals and adjustments.

● Clean up miscategorized or historical transactions to restore reliable books.



Accounts payable and receivable

● Process vendor bills, verify approvals and schedule vendor payments.

● Prepare property owner invoices and progress billing, and follow up on collections.

● Maintain AP and AR aging reports and resolve discrepancies with vendors and clients.



Reconciliations and month-end close

● Reconcile bank, loan and corporate credit card accounts monthly.

● Run the month-end close checklist and deliver closing entries on schedule.

● Prepare P&L, balance sheet and cash flow reports for management review.

● Perform P&L variance analysis and explain significant movements in plain English.



Payroll and billing

● Process payroll and reconcile payroll liabilities.

● Manage billing cycles, including job-based and project billing.



Insurance accounting

● Record insurance policies as prepaid assets and maintain amortization schedules.

● Track policy renewals and reconcile insurance-related accounts.



Systems and data

● Support AppFolio migrations (for example, Desktop to Online) and validate converted financial data.

● Keep data consistent across AppFolio and other applications.



Process improvement and controls

● Write and update SOPs for recurring accounting tasks.

● Recommend and apply internal controls that reduce errors and fraud risk.

● Improve finance workflows to shorten close time and reduce manual work.

Throughout

● Raise what does not reconcile. A number that will not tie out gets escalated with what you found — never

adjusted to fit.





Qualifications

● Bachelor’s degree in Accountancy, Accounting, Finance or a related field.

● Then EITHER: 5+ years of accounting or bookkeeping experience, including 2+ years supporting U.S.-based

companies —

● OR: Philippine CPA licensure (PRC-registered, CPALE passer). We will consider a recent passer with strong

fundamentals in place of the experience requirement, and train you on our systems.

● Hands-on experience running month-end close and preparing financial statements — or, for a recent CPA

passer, the technical grounding to learn it quickly.

● Strong Excel skills.

● Strong attention to detail, with a record of accurate reconciliations and clean books.

● Clear written and spoken English for working with U.S. owners, vendors and project managers.

● Ability to work independently, meet close deadlines and manage several clients or entities at once.

● A real system for closing on time. You work from a checklist and a calendar, not memory, and you can say

exactly what is still open at any point in the close. You will be asked to show it.

● Discretion with sensitive financial information.

● Reliable computer, stable internet (≥100 Mbps) with a backup connection, and a backup-power plan.



Preferred Qualifications

● Hands-on AppFolio experience — or AppFolio certification or formal AppFolio training. We will train the right

candidate on our systems.

● Construction accounting: job costing, progress billing, retainage and WIP reporting.

● Real estate accounting: property-level books, rent rolls and owner reporting.

● Working knowledge of U.S. GAAP, U.S. payroll basics and accrual accounting.

● Familiarity with QuickBase, CheckCentral, Buildertrend or Bluebeam.



The Boundaries of This Role

For clarity, and for your protection as much as ours, this role does NOT include:

● Approval authority over money. You prepare and reconcile payables and payment runs; the Owner approves

and releases them.



● Banking-portal credentials, wire initiation, check printing, or company card credentials.

● Signature authority or committing the Company to any agreement.

● Owner-relationship or commercial-terms decisions, or legal and rent-control work product.



What We Offer

● Full-time, remote, aligned to U.S. Pacific business hours.

● US$ 7.00 - 8.00 per hour, paid in USD via Wise.

● A monthly health allowance.

● A growth path toward a higher-level position — we promote from inside before we post outside.



How to Apply — Read Carefully

To be considered, your application MUST include all of the following, exactly as described. Applications missing any

item will not be reviewed.

# Include with your application

1. Internet speed proof. A Speedtest.net screenshot showing at least 25 Mbps download, shared as a

Google Drive link.

2. A quick accounting check (show your work): On October 1, a company paid $18,000 for a 12-month

insurance policy. (a) How much insurance expense is recorded each month? (b) What is the prepaid

insurance balance on December 31? (c) Write the journal entry for October 31.

3. A short writing sample. Write a brief, professional
 to a project manager asking for missing

receipts for three corporate credit card charges. You need them before month-end close on the 5th.

4. Three short answers (a few sentences each): (a) How long have you used AppFolio, and which

accounting tasks did you handle in it? (b) How do you make sure nothing is missed during month-end

close? (c) Your internet provider and your backup plan for an internet outage and for a power outage.

5. Rate and availability. 



Why these? The accounting check and the writing sample mirror the daily work. Strong applications that follow

instructions move to a short skills test, a video interview, and reference checks.



Our Process

● Application review — we check that every item above is included and that the accounting check is correct.

● Short skills test (about 30 minutes) — reconcile a sample bank statement and post three month-end journal

entries in Excel.

● Final interview — a video call that walks through your test answers and covers experience and fit, including a

look at how you track a close.

● Reference checks, then offer.



Only candidates who pass the skills test reach the final interview, so interview time goes to proven applicants.

title: Telemarketer
description:
B2B Appointment Setter & List Researcher — long-term, remote, paid hourly



THE ROLE



You call small and mid-sized businesses in Western Canada (BC and Alberta) and book short intro meetings between the person in charge of their employee benefits plan and our advisor. You are not selling insurance — you're booking a 30-minute conversation. A full operations manual, proven script and objection responses are provided.



Our clients tell us they stay with us for three things: sustainable rate savings, clarity in their coverage (no surprises at claim time), and an advisor who responds quickly, is patient, and acts in their best interest. Your call is a prospect's first taste of that experience — every call should sound like it.



This job is two jobs, and we value them equally:



-Calling (the visible half): friendly, unhurried cold calls during Pacific/Mountain business hours — gatekeepers, decision makers, objections, and booking meetings via Calendly.

-Research & data (the hidden half): verifying phone numbers and decision makers on company websites, enriching new lists before dialing, and keeping meticulous dated notes in our spreadsheet. The first pass through any new list is mostly cleanup — that is expected, and it's exactly why we pay by the hour, not per call.



YOU'RE A FIT IF



-Your spoken English is fluent and natural — you sound like a friendly colleague, not a script reader.

-You're meticulous: every dial logged the moment you hang up, dates as YYYY-MM-DD, notes a stranger could pick up and continue from.

-You're patient and steady — you'd rather build clean data and 3–6 solid meetings a week than burn through a list for volume.

-You're honest on the phone: comfortable saying “good question — that's exactly what the meeting is for” instead of bluffing.

-You want one long-term client and are reliably available during Canadian business hours.



YOU'RE NOT A FIT IF



-You're paid-per-call minded: maximum dials, minimum notes, next gig.

-You find the research/data-entry half of the work beneath you.

-Your style is pressure, exaggeration, or arguing past a “no.”



THE ONE NON-NEGOTIABLE



You are our brand to every person you reach. Protecting the brand outranks any single meeting: courteous, honest, zero pressure, on every call. “Don't call again” is honoured forever. If a call turns sour, exit politely and log it.



WHAT WE PROVIDE



A complete operations manual with scripts and objection handling, a researched call list, spreadsheet conventions, Calendly for booking, and regular debriefs and coaching directly with the principal. We invest in one caller who gets better every month.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



First two weeks: list enriched, script comfortable in your own words. Steady state: 100–150 dials a day, 15–25 real decision-maker conversations, 3–6 booked meetings a week — and a spreadsheet that's always current. Meetings booked and data quality are what we measure; dials are just how you get there.



HOW TO APPLY



Please don't send a resume or reply here — send a short video (2–3 minutes). Introduce yourself, tell us about your calling and research experience, and speak to us the way you'd speak to a business owner on a Tuesday morning. Then, so we know you actually read this page, finish your video by telling us the three things our clients say they stay with us for. Videos that skip that last part won't be considered — attention to detail is the job.

What's Hard About This Job

Working Remotely - We're a remote-first company, and we never want to have an office. This is great if you like working by yourself in the quiet, but it can be terribly painful if you need the energy of coworkers nearby.

Our Cultural Values - We're an American company with an incredibly unusual culture. Even by American standards, our 7 cultural values are highly unusual. Cheat Code for getting a job with us:

My examples of things I've done prove that my actions match my values system.

3) Be vulnerable and honest. We take very detailed notes during the interview process, and we conduct extensive background checks. If the stories you tell about yourself don't match what your references say, we will not hire you. We'd rather hire a C student who is honest about being a C student than someone who is a C student but tries to pass themselves off as an A student. Remember, this is an entry-level job. title: Full-Time Senior STR Listing Optimization, Copywriting & Marketing Specialist (Multi-PMS / Multi-OTA)
description:
Cire Homes is an established, fast-growing short-term rental management and optimization company based in Atlanta, Georgia (USA). Founded by former Airbnb Ambassadors and Customer Service Experts, we run on a "Process-First" culture with clear SOPs, organized workflows, and long-term team stability.



We are looking for a senior-level, full-time Listing Optimization & Growth Content Specialist to join our core operations team. In this role, you will manage and optimize listings for our internal portfolio and for external vacation rental clients—while also helping us create the sales materials, lead magnets, blog posts, and training SOPs we use to market and scale this service.



If you combine deep technical knowledge of OTA backends and multiple Property Management Systems with strong English copywriting, presentation, and documentation skills, this is a stable, long-term career role with significant growth potential.



What You Will Do



1. Recurring Listing Optimization & Sync Management

You will manage listings across Airbnb, Vrbo, 
, Expedia, and additional booking channels. Hostaway is our primary internal PMS, and you will also work inside external client accounts across Guesty, Lodgify, Hostfully, OwnerRez, Hospitable, and other top industry platforms on a clear recurring schedule:



Every Week (Sync Checks & Algorithm Updates):



Multi-PMS to OTA Quality Audits: Compare Hostaway, Guesty, Lodgify, Hostfully, and other client PMS systems against live OTA listings to fix technical glitches—such as amenities randomly unchecking themselves, photo counts not matching (e.g., 57 photos in the PMS vs. 12 showing on an OTA), or dates showing available in the PMS but blocked on an OTA.



Title & Amenity Updates: Update listing titles for upcoming holidays, local events, and seasons, and verify that key search tags (EV charger, workspace, crib, etc.) stay active.



Algorithm "Heartbeat" Edits: Make regular, strategic listing updates to keep properties ranking high in search results.



Every 2 Weeks (Competitor Research & Promotions):



Competitor Analysis: Check top-performing competing listings in each property's area to see how our photos, titles, and offers compare.



OTA Promotions: Set up and monitor platform deals (
 Genius/Mobile rates, Expedia Member Deals, Airbnb promotions).



Every Month (New Channels & Photo Audits):



New OTA Listing Creation: Create, connect, and optimize listings on additional/niche OTAs beyond the main four platforms, aligned with each client's PMS.



Photo Ordering & Captions: Review photo order and captions across every platform to make sure the best images appear first.



Monthly Reporting: Log completed optimizations and share clear monthly updates on listing health and improvements.



Every Quarter (Deep Content & Copy Refresh):



Full Listing Rewrites: Refresh property descriptions, neighborhood highlights, and house rules for upcoming seasons or newly added property upgrades.



Full Account & Policy Check: Review fees, cancellation policies, and brand consistency across all connected platforms.



2. Sales Collateral, Content Marketing & Training SOPs

You will also help market and systematize our listing optimization service by creating:



Sales Copy & Presentation Decks: Write persuasive B2B sales copy, case studies, and data-backed slide decks used to present our optimization service to prospective clients.



Lead Magnets & Blog Posts: Create high-value downloadable guides/checklists (lead magnets) and SEO blog articles to attract property owners and hosts.



Training Processes & Documentation: Build step-by-step training guides and SOPs so our internal processes remain documented, repeatable, and scalable across all PMS tools.



Who We Are Looking For



Multi-OTA Backend Experience: Hands-on experience inside 
 Extranet and Expedia Partner Central, in addition to Airbnb and Vrbo.



Multi-PMS Experience: Strong working knowledge of Hostaway (our primary system) alongside other major STR platforms like Guesty, Lodgify, Hostfully, OwnerRez, or Hospitable—plus the ability to quickly adapt to any PMS a client uses.



Expert English Copywriting & Marketing Skills: Proven ability to write persuasive guest-facing listing copy as well as B2B sales copy, blog posts, lead magnets, and slide deck content.



Process & Documentation Mindset: Experience creating clean training SOPs, checklists, and structured presentations.



Full-Time Commitment: Looking for one stable, full-time (40 hours/week) role—not juggling multiple full-time jobs.



How to Apply

To apply, please put the word ATLANTA at the very top of your message so we know you read the entire post. In your application, please answer these four questions:



Which Property Management Systems (e.g., Hostaway, Guesty, Lodgify, Hostfully, OwnerRez) and OTAs have you worked with directly?



What is one specific thing you do inside 
 or Expedia to improve a listing's ranking or score?



Please share links or samples of sales copy, a pitch deck, a lead magnet, or a blog post you have written.



Are you available for a full-time, long-term position (40 hours/week)?

title: Professional Amazon Seller Central Manager
description:

Only experienced candidates need apply. Experience should be specialized in Amazon services only.



**Company:** Charlotte Home Furnishings Inc.

**Industry:** Premium European Home Décor

**Location:** Remote

**Job Type:** Full-Time / Contract (depending on experience)



## About Us



Charlotte Home Furnishings Inc. is a premium home décor brand offering high-quality European-made products, including tapestries, cushion covers, table runners, throws, and other elegant textile furnishings. We are focused on building a strong, premium presence on Amazon through exceptional listings, account management, and operational excellence.



We are looking for an experienced **Amazon Seller Central Listings & Account Manager** to take ownership of our Amazon catalog and day-to-day Seller Central operations. This role is ideal for someone who understands how to build, optimize, and manage high-converting Amazon listings while maintaining account health, operational efficiency, and premium brand presentation.



**Important:** This role does **not** include PPC/advertising management. We are specifically seeking a specialist in **Amazon listings and Seller Central management**.



## Role Overview



The Amazon Seller Central Listings & Account Manager will be responsible for managing and optimizing our Amazon product listings, maintaining catalog accuracy, improving conversion through better content execution, overseeing Seller Central operations, and ensuring that our Amazon storefront reflects the quality and premium positioning of our brand.



This person should be highly experienced with Amazon Seller Central, flat files, listing variations, catalog troubleshooting, content optimization, image coordination, inventory monitoring, and account performance management.



## Key Responsibilities



### Amazon Listing Management & Optimization



* Create, upload, optimize, and maintain Amazon product listings for premium home décor products.

* Write and refine SEO-friendly product titles, bullet points, product descriptions, backend search terms, and A+ content briefs to improve discoverability and conversion.

* Manage parent-child variations, listing merges/splits, browse node issues, suppressed listings, stranded inventory issues, and catalog inconsistencies.

* Ensure listings accurately reflect product specifications, materials, dimensions, country of origin, care instructions, and premium brand positioning.

* Continuously audit existing listings and identify opportunities to improve CTR, conversion rate, content quality, and overall customer experience.

* Coordinate with creative/design teams to improve listing images, infographics, comparison charts, lifestyle imagery, and premium content presentation.



### Seller Central Account Management

* Monitor account health, voice of customer, listing quality dashboards, stranded inventory, suppressed listings, and performance notifications.

* Handle case log management and communicate with Amazon Seller Support to resolve listing, category, compliance, and catalog issues.

* Oversee catalog updates, SKU setup, variation corrections, pricing checks, and listing troubleshooting.

* Ensure product pages remain accurate, compliant, and optimized at all times.



### Inventory, Catalog & Operational Oversight



* Help manage product setup, SKU organization, and catalog structure for current and new launches.

* Monitor inventory levels and listing availability to help reduce stockouts and lost sales opportunities.

* Coordinate listing launches, updates, and seasonal content changes in an organized and timely manner.

* Maintain clean, structured Amazon catalog data and ensure consistency across listings.

* Assist in troubleshooting operational issues affecting listing visibility or sales performance.



### Performance & Growth Support



* Track listing-level performance metrics such as sessions, conversion rate, unit session percentage, sales trends, and Buy Box status.

* Identify underperforming listings and recommend actionable improvements in content, merchandising, images, or catalog structure.

* Work closely with ownership/management to support revenue growth through stronger listing quality, better catalog management, and improved customer-facing content.

* Provide regular reporting and recommendations on listing performance, catalog issues, account risks, and growth opportunities.



## Required Qualifications



* **Minimum 3–5+ years of hands-on Amazon Seller Central experience** managing listings and account operations.

* Strong experience with **Amazon catalog management** and **listing optimization** in Seller Central.

* Proven experience creating and optimizing product listings that improve conversion and sales performance.

* Deep understanding of:



 * Amazon SEO and listing structure

 * Parent-child variations

 * Flat files and bulk uploads

 * Listing suppression issues

 * Inventory file templates

 * Seller Central troubleshooting

 * Account health and catalog compliance

* Experience managing Amazon listings for **premium consumer products**, ideally in home décor, furnishings, textiles, lifestyle, or similar categories.

* Strong written English and the ability to create polished, premium, customer-focused listing content.

* Highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive in identifying and solving issues.

* Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of Amazon account operations.



## Preferred Qualifications



* Experience with **premium home décor, textiles, furnishings, or lifestyle brands**.

* Experience working with premium or European-made products and presenting craftsmanship, material quality, and design heritage effectively on Amazon.

* Familiarity with Amazon Brand Registry and premium content execution.

* Ability to work strategically while also managing the day-to-day operational details of Seller Central.

* Amazon listings are fully optimized, accurate, visually compelling, and aligned with our premium brand.

* Listing quality and conversion performance improve over time.

* Seller Central is organized, actively managed, and closely monitored.

2. Examples of Amazon listings or brands you have managed.

3. A summary of your experience with listing optimization, catalog troubleshooting, and Seller Central account management.

title: On-Camera Female Presenter for YouTube Videos (Men's Wellness & Relationships)
description:
We run a YouTube channel for men over 50 about relationships, intimacy, confidence and healthy habits. 



We're looking for a warm, natural woman to be the face of the channel. You'll present scripts we provide, on camera, from home. You are a friendly host, not a doctor or an expert, and you won't be presented as one.



Please read before applying:

The topics include men's sexual wellness and dating. The content is educational and non-graphic, with no nudity and no explicit language, but you will be talking about adult subjects on camera. Only apply if you're comfortable with that.



What you'll do:

- Record 5 videos per session, each 15-20 minutes, using a teleprompter app

- Talk to the camera like a real person talking to a friend, not like you're reading

- Add your own words, reactions, and little stories whenever it makes the script feel more alive. You have the freedom to make it your own.

- Re-record a section if we ask for it

- Clear, natural English that's easy for American listeners to follow

- Relaxed and expressive on camera. We want real, not stiff or robotic.

- Comfortable going off-script a little and keeping the energy up for a few hours

- Smartphone or webcam, a quiet room, and stable internet

- Ring light and a decent microphone, or willingness to get them

- Reliable and on time

- You should look mature (above 30, the older the better) since your audience is men over 50.



No experience needed. We'll guide you.

title: Follow-Up Specialist (Real Estate)
description:
We're Hiring: Follow-Up Specialist (Real Estate)

Location: Remote

Industry: Real Estate / Cash Home Buying



About the Role

We're looking for a highly organized, persistent, and relationship-driven Follow-Up Specialist to manage and nurture inbound seller leads.



In this role, you'll take ownership of the lead follow-up process, ensuring every inquiry receives timely attention and no potential opportunity gets lost in the pipeline.



You'll serve as the bridge between inbound leads and the acquisitions team, building meaningful connections with prospective sellers through consistent, personalized, and empathetic communication.



This position is ideal for someone who enjoys talking to people, thrives in a high-volume environment, and understands that successful follow-up requires both persistence and genuine relationship-building.

Key Responsibilities

1. New Lead Response & Management

- Contact every new inbound lead within 10 minutes of receiving an inquiry, primarily through phone calls.

- Make multiple contact attempts throughout the day for leads that have not yet been reached.

- Prioritize new inquiries to ensure timely engagement and prevent missed opportunities.

- Record all calls, conversations, and follow-up activities in the CRM.

2. Daily Lead Follow-Up & Campaign Management

- Work through prioritized lead lists daily, following the established urgency and contact cadence.

- Maintain consistent follow-up schedules across different lead stages:

  - Recent leads (0–7 days): 3–5 contact attempts per week.

  - Leads (8–30 days): 2–3 contact attempts per week.

  - Older leads (1–6 months and 6+ months): Maintain regular follow-up campaigns.

- Review and work through missed follow-up tasks at least once every two weeks.

- Alternate between dialer campaigns and click-to-call strategies to maximize contact and answer rates.

3. Relationship Building & Communication

- Build rapport with prospective sellers through genuine, empathetic, and conversational interactions.

- Understand each seller's circumstances, which may include divorce, foreclosure, inherited properties, or financial challenges.

- Personalize conversations based on each lead's situation rather than relying solely on scripted communication.

- Follow up through phone calls, text messages, and
s when prospects are unavailable.

4. CRM Management & Reporting

- Maintain accurate and up-to-date CRM records after every interaction, including notes, lead status, and next follow-up dates.

- Track qualified leads successfully passed to the acquisitions team.

- Monitor campaign performance and provide regular updates on lead conversions.

- Identify recurring patterns, opportunities, and challenges, and communicate relevant insights to leadership.



What We're Looking For

- Excellent phone communication skills with a warm, confident, and natural conversational style.

- Strong organizational skills and the ability to independently manage a high-volume follow-up pipeline.

- High levels of discipline, accountability, and consistency.

- Strong emotional intelligence and empathy when dealing with sellers in sensitive or challenging situations.

- Persistent and proactive, without being overly aggressive or pushy.

- Excellent written communication skills, particularly for personalized text messages and
s.

- Comfortable making a high volume of daily calls.

- Strong attention to detail, especially in CRM documentation and data management.

- Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

- Previous experience in outbound calling, inside sales, lead management, appointment setting, or customer service.

- Familiarity with CRM platforms, particularly Podio.

- Experience using auto-dialers or power dialers, such as BatchDialer.

- Background in real estate, property management, or sales-driven environments is an advantage.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, and Excel.

- Familiarity with team communication tools such as Slack.

No real estate experience? That's okay! Full training on processes, systems, and workflows will be provided. We're more interested in your willingness to learn, adaptability, and ability to follow through.



Tools & Platforms

- CRM: Podio

- Auto-Dialer: BatchDialer or similar power dialer

- Communication: Slack

- Productivity Tools: Microsoft Outlook, Word, and Excel



How Success Is Measured

- Lead Response Time: New inbound leads contacted within 10 minutes.

- Follow-Up Completion: 100% of scheduled follow-up tasks completed on time.

- Campaign Pass Rate: Number of qualified leads successfully handed off to the acquisitions team.

- Contact Rate: Percentage of leads successfully reached through outreach efforts.

title: Behavioral Health Medical Biller & Credentialing Specialist | IOP + Outpatient
description:
We are a Behavioral Health facility  provider in Florida. We offer outpatient mental health services and substance use intensive outpatient treatment (IOP) for adults and adolescents. We will open PHP soon. We serve people in recovery, trauma survivors, veterans, and families in our community.



We’re preparing to submit our first insurance claims and are looking for someone who wants to grow with us long term. Your first priority will be helping us get claims out accurately, follow them through payment, and keep our most important payer applications moving.



What you’ll do

- Handle billing from benefits verification through payment. Verify eligibility and benefits before the first visit, confirm authorization requirements, and track approved visits and expiration dates.

- Prepare IOP and outpatient claims. Use UB-04/837I or CMS-1500/837P according to the payer and contract. Verify IOP per diem codes, revenue codes, modifiers, place of service, provider information, and authorizations. Flag documentation issues for the clinical team before submission.

- Follow claims through resolution. Correct clearinghouse rejections, work denials and underpayments, submit appeals, post payments from ERAs and EOBs, and reconcile payments.

- Support facility contracting and clinician credentialing. Track applications under our Type 2 organizational NPI, maintain clinician rosters and CAQH profiles, and verify approved services and effective dates. Payers may include Florida Medicaid plans, commercial insurers, VA Community Care, TRICARE, Medicare, and EAPs, depending on our enrollment priorities.

- Help set up our billing workflow. Coordinate EDI, ERA, and EFT enrollments, work in Availity and payer portals, and help test claims in our new EHR and Stedi workflow using test data.

- Keep us updated. Send a short weekly summary of claims, payments, denials, and pending payer applications. Help document billing procedures as we grow.



What we’re looking for

- At least three years of U.S. medical billing experience, including behavioral health and hands-on denial follow-up.

- Experience with both institutional and professional claims. Direct experience billing substance use IOP or PHP is strongly preferred.

- Hands-on payer enrollment or credentialing experience. Facility contracting under a Type 2 NPI is strongly preferred.

- Experience with Medicaid managed care and commercial insurance. Florida payer experience, especially with Molina, Aetna, Cigna/Evernorth, or Optum, is a plus.

- Experience with single case agreements, rate requests, payer audits, or recoupment appeals is a plus. CPB, CPC, or CRCR certification is welcome.

- Clear spoken and written English, reliable internet, and a private workspace. Must complete privacy onboarding and follow our HIPAA and substance use record confidentiality procedures.



How to apply

Attach  your résumé or relevant work history with dates, your Eastern Time availability, and brief answers to these questions.



1. Which behavioral health programs have you personally billed for? Include the services, payers, and claim formats you used. If you’ve billed IOP, explain what you would verify before submitting one day of service to a Florida Medicaid plan and a commercial plan.



2. Have you worked on a facility contract under a Type 2 NPI or negotiated a single case agreement? Tell us which payer was involved, what you personally handled, and what happened.



3. Tell us about a denial, underpayment, or recoupment you worked on. What caused it, what did you do, and what was the result?



4. As a start up explain how you can help us grow and if you have prior experience in this



5. PLEASE ONLY apply if you have experience.

title: Real Estate Acquisitions VA (Inland Empire, CA
description:
About me

I'm a real estate investor buying fixers and small multifamily (1–4 units) in the Inland Empire: San Bernardino, Highland, Colton, Rialto and Fontana. I focus on closing deals and running renovations. I need an experienced VA to run everything else on the deal-finding side.



What you'll do



 • Find deals: search the MLS, Zillow and Redfin daily for stale listings, price cuts, fixers, probate and expired listings.

 • Pull lists: absentee owners, free-and-clear properties, long-time owners, vacant homes and pre-foreclosures, using PropStream, DealMachine or BatchLeads.

 • Find owner contact info and manage it in a CRM.

 • Reach out to sellers by phone, text or mail, following DNC and TCPA rules.

 • Run the numbers: after-repair value from sold comps, rent comps, a rough repair estimate, and the maximum offer.

 • Follow up with sellers and agents until there's a yes or a no.

 • Coordinate with agents, contractors, lenders and escrow, and keep my calendar and pipeline organized.

 • Send me a weekly report: leads, conversations, offers made, and deals in progress.



Must have



 • 2+ years of US real estate investing experience (acquisitions, wholesaling or underwriting)

 • Hands-on experience with PropStream, DealMachine or BatchLeads, plus a CRM (Podio, REsimpli, GoHighLevel or similar)

 • Can pull comps and explain an after-repair value

 • Understands seller financing and creative deal structures

 • Strong written and spoken English

 • Available to work during Pacific time business hours



Nice to have



 • California or Inland Empire market experience

 • Cold calling experience with a track record you can show

 • Experience working with contractors or project management



Pay: Hourly pay plus a bonus for every deal I close that you found.



How to apply (this is the test)



Find one real property in San Bernardino, Highland, Colton or Rialto that you think is a good deal, and send me:



 1.  The address and listing link (or how you found it if it's off-market)

 2.  The asking price, beds and baths, square footage, and year built

 3.  The after-repair value, backed by 3 sold comparable homes (addresses, sale prices, dates)

 4.  A repair estimate, with what needs fixing

 5.  The maximum offer, using after-repair value × 70% − repairs

 6.  Why the seller might be motivated: time owned, days on market, price cuts, vacancy, and so on

 7.  Whether the seller could offer financing, and why you think so

 8.  Rent estimate for keeping it as a rental (with rent comps)



Rules:

 • Start your application with the word "HIGHLAND" so I know you read the whole post.

 • Applications without a deal won't be reviewed.



Deadline: The top 2–3 applicants get a paid trial week before I hire.

title: Amazon PPC Specialist
description:
Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full-time (9hrs), 8-hour shift with a 1-hour lunch break

Schedule: At least 5 hours of overlap with Pacific Time business hours



About the Role



Triple Line Brands is looking for an Amazon PPC Specialist to support the day-to-day advertising work for consumer brands across their Amazon marketplaces.

This is an execution and analysis-focused role. You will carry out advertising plans set by a Senior Amazon PPC Strategist, build and optimize campaigns, maintain account hygiene, analyze performance data, and prepare accurate reports. The Strategist will own account strategy and higher-judgment decisions, while you will own the accuracy, quality, documentation, and timely completion of assigned PPC work.

This role is well suited to someone who enjoys working with data, identifying inconsistencies, following structured processes, and translating clear performance targets into specific campaign changes.





What You’ll Do



Build, manage, and optimize Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Brands Video, and Sponsored Display campaigns based on approved advertising plans.

Conduct keyword and product-targeting research, search-term analysis and harvesting, negative targeting, and routine account reviews.

Translate account-specific ROAS, ACOS, CPC, conversion, and budget-pacing goals into appropriate bid, placement, targeting, and budget adjustments.

Download, organize, analyze, and validate advertising and performance data using Excel or Google Sheets.

Review datasets, reports, and dashboards for missing information, duplicates, incorrect filters, formula errors, unusual results, and inconsistencies between sources.

Monitor sales, spend, TACOS, ACOS, ROAS, CPC, conversion rate, and other relevant performance measures.

Diagnose significant performance gaps or fluctuations, identify likely root causes, and recommend appropriate actions for Strategist review.

Compile, check, and submit PPC performance reports accurately and on time.

Maintain campaign hygiene, including organized structures, naming conventions, targeting, budgets, and campaign uptime.

Document campaign changes, actions taken, test progress, results, and follow-up items.

Support the Senior PPC Strategist with data preparation, reporting, account research, audits, and other PPC-related tasks that help brands progress toward their goals.

Flag risks, blockers, unclear instructions, data issues, or decisions outside your guidelines to the Senior PPC Strategist.

Apply department standards and share practical feedback that could improve campaign execution, reporting, quality assurance, and team workflows.





What We’re Looking For



At least two years of hands-on Amazon PPC experience, with the full two years spent managing multiple Amazon advertising accounts or marketplaces at the same time for established consumer brands with meaningful ad spend.

Amazon agency experience is preferred.

Comfortable managing approximately 10 to 12 substantive brand-marketplace assignments when fully ramped, subject to account complexity and workload capacity.

Strong data analysis skills and exceptional attention to detail.

Experience reviewing and validating PPC datasets, reports, dashboards, or analytical models.

Ability to diagnose performance problems, identify likely root causes, and recommend appropriate actions.

Strong understanding of campaign structures, match types, bidding, placements, budget management, keyword targeting, product targeting, search-term harvesting, and negative targeting.

Ability to translate quantified performance goals into specific campaign optimization actions.

Strong proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, lookups, pivot tables, filters, and data validation.

Ability to identify reporting errors, inconsistencies between data sources, and meaningful changes in account performance.

Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

Ability to learn new brands, products, tools, and workflows quickly.

Comfortable working in a dynamic environment with multiple accounts and evolving priorities.

Organized, dependable, receptive to feedback, and proactive about communicating risks, blockers, and opportunities to improve team processes.

Familiarity with Helium 10, SmartScout, My Real Profit, Atom11, or similar platforms is an advantage.

Amazon DSP experience is a strong advantage, with advanced proficiency preferred but not required.

Experience working remotely with US-based brands or cross-functional teams is an advantage.





Why Join Us



You’ll work on a varied portfolio of Amazon brands with clear strategic direction and defined performance goals. You’ll receive account-specific coaching from a Senior PPC Strategist and support from advertising leadership while strengthening your campaign execution, data analysis, and reporting skills.





How to Apply



Please include a link to your résumé in your application and make sure we have permission to view it. If you have a portfolio of relevant Amazon PPC work, feel free to include a link to it as well.





Salary posted is negotiable

ing US property owners directly

title: Real Estate Operations Manager
description:
About the Role



We are looking for a highly detail-oriented Real Estate Executive Operations Manager to serve as the operational backbone of our fast-paced real estate team.



This is not a passive administrative desk. You will bridge the gap between high-stakes contract-to-close transaction management and executive operations—working directly alongside our lead agent, external marketing and tech specialists, title/lender partners, and brokerage compliance.



Key Responsibilities

1. Contract-to-Close Transaction & Compliance Management

End-to-End File Management: Manage active buyer and seller files from executed contract through closing, recording, and post-close wrap-up (MLS closeout, lockbox/sign retrieval, utility transfers, and key/manual handoffs).



Brokerage Compliance & Commission Unblocking: Audit files in BoldTrail and TransactionDesk / Authentisign to ensure every required Arizona (AAR) form (SPDS, BINSR, ABAD, Buyer-Broker Agreements, signing certificates) is properly executed and uploaded within strict deadlines to prevent holds on Commission Disbursement Authorizations (CDAs).

Title, Lender & Client Handoffs: Coordinate wire cutoffs, walkthrough schedules, pre-qualification uploads, and closing readiness updates across title officers, lenders, and clients.



2. Executive Operations & Vendor Coordination

Multi-Channel Triage & EOD Reporting: Monitor incoming requests across
, RingCentral/SMS, and team workspaces, translating rapid-fire updates into concrete deadlines (anchored to Arizona time) and delivering a structured End-of-Day (EOD) status report with task IDs, blockers, and links to proof.



Cross-Team Project Orchestration: Act as the central point of contact between the lead agent and external specialists (social media, video production, web/SEO, and bookkeeping)—tracking deliverable proofs without duplicating work.



Software, Billing & Brand Hygiene: Maintain our internal tools inventory, track software cancellations/disputes through to written confirmation, manage RingCentral call/voi
 routing, and ensure consistent HREG / EveryPlace branding across Zillow, Flexmls, Google Business Profile, and
 signatures.



3. CRM & Client Experience Operations

Database Integrity (Follow Up Boss): Maintain clean contact records, log detailed call/voi
 notes, segment audiences for targeted outreach, and enforce strict SMS "STOP" opt-out and data-retention rules.



Client Touchpoints & Tours: Prepare buyer tour itineraries/CMAs, send post-consultation seller prep checklists, and manage active-client communication preferences and listing alerts.



What We’re Looking For

Required Experience:



2+ years of experience as a Real Estate Transaction Coordinator, Real Estate Executive Assistant, or Operations Manager (Arizona real estate experience and familiarity with AAR forms strongly preferred).



Proven proficiency in BoldTrail (or kvCORE), TransactionDesk / Authentisign, Follow Up Boss, Flexmls / ARMLS, Aligned Showings / Supra, and Google Workspace.



Experience working within RingCentral (or similar multi-line VoIP/SMS platforms).



Core Strengths:



Obsession with Closing Loops: You follow up persistently until you have written confirmation or an approved file in hand—never assuming an
 sent equals a task done.



Deadline Precision: When given a general timeframe ("tomorrow" or "soon"), you instinctively clarify exact clock cutoffs and manage schedules strictly on Arizona time.



Calm Under Shifting Priorities: You can drop a routine marketing audit to urgently clear a title wire hold, and seamlessly pick the audit back up afterward without dropping a single detail.



High Integrity & Discretion: Comfortable handling sensitive client records, wire/commission details, and account access protocols cleanly and securely.
