title: ☀️ Experienced B2B Lead Researcher – Commercial Solar, EV Charging & Battery Storage 🔋⚡
description:
Long-Term Opportunity | Flexible Hours | $5/Hour**



About Us



We help commercial property owners turn their roofs, parking lots, and land into income and savings.



Our solutions include:



- Commercial Rooftop Solar: We sell solar systems or pay property owners to lease their roofs.

- EV Charging Stations: We develop EV charging stations in high-traffic locations.

- Battery Energy Storage (BESS): We help businesses reduce high utility demand charges.

- Standalone BESS Site Leases: We pay landowners to host battery storage systems on their properties.



Target Areas: Connecticut, New York City (five boroughs only), Northern New Jersey, and Massachusetts.



Excluded Areas: Long Island (Nassau and Suffolk counties).



We're looking for an experienced B2B Lead Researcher who can identify qualified commercial properties, find the right decision-makers, and build accurate, high-quality contact lists for our outreach campaigns.



If you're detail-oriented, resourceful, and skilled at finding hard-to-find business contacts using free research methods, we'd love to hear from you!



 Compensation & Schedule



- $5 per hour

- 20–40 hours per week

- Flexible working hours – work at any time that suits you, provided you meet weekly lead targets.

- Long-term opportunity for the right candidate.

- Paid weekly via Wise, PayPal, or Upwork.



What You'll Do



You'll be responsible for researching commercial properties and identifying qualified decision-makers across our target markets.



 1. Research Commercial Properties & Opportunities



Find businesses and property owners that match our four opportunity categories:



Commercial Rooftop Solar (ROOF)**

- Warehouses

- Manufacturing facilities

- Distribution centers

- Cold storage facilities

- Schools and hospitals

- Big-box retail properties



EV Charging Stations (EV):

- Shopping centers

- Hotels

- Gas stations

- Convenience stores

- Restaurants

- Grocery stores

- Parking garages

- Apartment complexes



Battery Energy Storage (BESS):

- Manufacturing facilities

- Cold storage facilities

- Data centers

- Food processing companies

- Hospitals

- Other high-energy-use businesses



Standalone BESS Site Leases:

- Industrial lots

- Vacant commercial land

- Commercial properties near utility substations

- Landowners with suitable properties for battery storage installations



 2. Identify the Right Decision-Makers



Find and research relevant decision-makers, including:



- Owner

- CEO

- CFO

- Facilities Director

- Operations Manager

- Energy Manager

- Property Manager

- Asset Manager

- Real Estate Director



 3. Find & Verify Contact Information



For every lead, research and verify:



- Business
 address

- Personal
 address

- Phone number (direct line or mobile preferred)

- LinkedIn profile



Use free research methods and resources, including LinkedIn, company websites, Google searches, public records, and free-tier research tools.



Accuracy is more important than speed.



4. Maintain & Update Lead Databases



- Categorize every lead by opportunity type: Roof, EV, BESS, or Standalone BESS.

- Check all new leads against our existing database of 40,000+ contacts to prevent duplicates.

- Research and complete missing information on existing contacts.

- Enter all information into a well-organized Google Sheet.

- Maintain accurate, complete, and consistent records.



 Requirements:



- At least 2 years of B2B lead generation or lead research experience.

- Proven ability to find business
s, personal
s, and phone numbers using free research methods.

- Strong online research and data verification skills.

- Excellent attention to detail.

- Good written English communication skills.

- Reliable and responsive, with replies to messages within 24 hours.

- Ability to work independently and consistently meet weekly lead targets.



 Nice to Have:



- Experience in solar, renewable energy, EV charging, or battery storage.

- Background in construction or commercial real estate lead generation.

- Familiarity with the Northeast U.S. market.

- Experience building and maintaining large B2B contact databases.



 How to Apply:



To demonstrate that you've carefully read the job description, please follow these application instructions:



1. Start your application with the words **Smart Roof**.

2. In 3–5 sentences, explain how you find and verify business
s, personal
s, and phone numbers without using paid databases or tools.

3. Tell us your approximate number of complete leads you can produce per hour. A complete lead must include a decision-maker's name, job title, verified business
, verified personal
, and phone number.

4. Share 1–2 previous lead generation projects you've handled, including the industry, number of leads generated, and results if available.





We're looking for someone who can become a reliable, long-term member of our team and help us build a strong pipeline of qualified commercial opportunities.



If you have the research skills and attention to detail we're looking for, apply now. We look forward to seeing your work!

title: Hiring: Full-Time Product Researcher & eBay Lister
description:
Hiring: Full-Time Product Researcher & eBay Lister



Join Our Growing Ebay Team!



We are a growing eBay dropshipping business with a small team that already includes several Filipino employees. We manage many eBay accounts and are looking for a motivated person to join us for a long-term opportunity.



We are looking for someone who is willing to learn, work consistently, and grow with our company.



Job Responsibilities



•⁠  ⁠Find profitable products for our eBay accounts.

•⁠  ⁠Research products and provide suitable product links.

•⁠  ⁠List products across multiple eBay accounts.

•⁠  ⁠Work closely with our account managers and supervisors and attend bi-weekly team meetings

•⁠  ⁠Follow training instructions course and maintain good productivity.



Training & Mentorship



You will receive a dedicated training course and direct guidance from two experienced supervisors.



During your initial training period, you will work directly with your supervisors, who will provide support throughout your 8-hour working day. Once you are properly trained, you will gradually transition into working with the wider team.



We also conduct bi-weekly team meetings where everyone can connect and discuss progress.



Salary & Benefits



•⁠  ⁠$500 monthly base salary after qualifying for full-time employment.

•⁠  ⁠Additional performance-based bonuses with the potential to earn substantial extra income.

•⁠  ⁠Dedicated training and mentorship.

•⁠  ⁠Opportunity to develop valuable product research skills.

•⁠  ⁠Long-term employment and career growth opportunities.



Our last two Filipino employees have been working with us full-time for more than six months, and we are looking to build a reliable and long-term team with a good culture.



Requirements



•⁠  ⁠Basic knowledge of eBay is sufficient.

•⁠  ⁠Very good spoken English and strong communication skills.

•⁠  ⁠Completed education (no longer a student).

•⁠  ⁠Reliable laptop and stable internet connection.

•⁠  ⁠Willingness to work full-time and learn new skills.

•⁠  ⁠Previous Amazon-to-eBay or AliExpress-to-eBay dropshipping experience is an advantage.



Working Conditions



•⁠  ⁠Fully remote position.

•⁠  ⁠8 working hours per day.

•⁠  ⁠5 days per week, with occasional 6-day weeks during busy periods.

•⁠  ⁠Sunday is always guaranteed off.

•⁠  ⁠First 1–2 months will be a paid part-time trial period with a fixed salary (To be discussed).

•⁠  ⁠Full-time employment will be offered based on your performance during the trial period.



Long-Term Opportunity



We are expanding our eBay business and plan to manage many many eBay accounts in the future. This creates an opportunity for the right person to grow with us, take on more responsibilities, and benefit from increased compensation over time.



How to Apply



Please send your CV and answer these questions:



1) What is your current internet speed (download and upload)?

2) Please explain your past experience with eBay and remote-access applications such as Anydesk and Rustdesk

3) Briefly explain a problem you encountered, how you overcame it, and what you learned.

4) Please state your available working hours (PHT time), and why you are interested in a full-time, long-term position

5) Where do you see yourself 5 years from now?

Growing FAST - We sold 2663 lessons in 2026 and we're on pace to sell 3328 lessons in 2027.

We sell manual transmission driving lessons in the United States. Yes, really.

Duties and Responsibilities

Sell Stick Shift Driving Lessons

Inbound Call Handling - Answer phones and talk to prospects through the sale or sign up

Outbound Follow-Up - Call, text, and
 to get the prospect to the finish line

Qualify Prospects - Make sure their needs fit our model

Secret Message: When you apply, under the section that says "Is there anything else you'd like to write or include?", write the word PINK ELEPHANT. This will show us that you read the entire job description.

Outbound Dialing - Dialing prospective customers and leaving voi
s.

Text Message and
 Handling - Quickly handle inbound text messages and
s that are sent to the salesperson.

Paperwork Follow-Up - Follow up with prospective customers who have not yet signed up to make sure they got the paperwork. Handle any issues they had with doing the paperwork.

Review Solicitation - Follow up with customers after the lesson to request a review on Google and Yelp

Edit customer records in our CRM (HubSpot)





Qualifications

Must have your own computer, reliable high-speed internet, and good quality headset and microphone.

English Grammar and Language: You must be fluent in English

Strong Problem-Solving skills

Customer Service Oriented and ability to adapt/respond properly to different types of scenarios

Ability to Multitask, prioritize and manage time effectively





What's Hard About This Job

Working Remotely - We're a remote-first company, and we never want to have an office. This is great if you like working by yourself in the quiet, but it can be terribly painful if you need the energy of coworkers nearby.

Our Cultural Values - We're an American company with an incredibly unusual culture. Even by American standards, our 7 cultural values are highly unusual. Our culture is challenging for people accustomed to corporate culture and especially difficult for people who grew up in Confucian cultures. It's a great culture for people who speak directly and have a great deal of self-confidence and ownership. If you identify as a misfit, you'll do well.

Multiple Software Systems - You're going to need to learn how to use 12 different software systems. This is great if you want to get exposed to and experienced with lots of technology, but it can be tough if you have a hard time learning technology. Secret Message - When you apply, you'll see a box that asks if you want to add anything else. Type in PINK ELEPHANT in all capital letters exactly as we've shown it here.





Cheat Code for getting a job with us:

1) Our application comprises the majority of our recruiting process. Because of that, we suggest that you give us thoughtful responses and rich stories. We typically only interview applicants who give rich and detailed answers to our questions. If you write short responses so that you can hurry up and finish the application, you will not get interviewed.

2) Tell us stories about how your actions match your beliefs and values. For example, if I say I value health and fitness, you don't know if I'm telling you the truth or if I'm just telling you what sounds good. But, if I tell you things I've done, I can illustrate my values of health and fitness with proof. For example, I go to the gym 4 days per week, I've done 6 triathlons, including an Ironman, and I can swim 3000 meters in one hour. My examples of things I've done prove that my actions match my values system.

3) Be vulnerable and honest. We take very detailed notes during the interview process, and we conduct extensive background checks. If the stories you tell about yourself don't match what your references say, we will not hire you. We'd rather hire a C student who is honest about being a C student than someone who is a C student but tries to pass themselves off as an A student. Remember, this is an entry-level job. We're not looking for perfect. We're looking for an excellent cultural fit.

title: Deal Analyst
description:
We help Americans unlock wealth and break free from the corporate 9–5 grind through business acquisitions. We’re a fast-growing, lean, fully remote team that moves quickly, stays organized, and executes with discipline. We own outcomes, protect quality, and push deals to close without unnecessary delays.



Our core values are Team-First Performance, Perfect Professionalism, and Mastery Through Feedback. We win together, communicate clearly and professionally, and continuously improve through direct, actionable feedback.



As a Deal Analyst, you play a critical role in keeping deals moving from LOI to Closing. 



You sit at the center of execution, coordinating buyers, brokers, lenders, diligence providers, and internal teams to ensure every step is completed accurately and on time. 



This is not a passive coordination role. You’re responsible for process discipline, follow-through, and speed in a high-volume M&A environment. If you’re detail-oriented, thrive in structured workflows, and hate missed steps, this role fits.





About the Role

We’re looking for a detail-driven, reliable analyst to own day-to-day deal execution. You’ll manage documentation, timelines, and stakeholder communication while enforcing SOPs to ensure deals progress smoothly from LOI through Closing. You’ll proactively flag issues, resolve bottlenecks, and help maintain a clean, audit-ready deal pipeline.



Results

-Deals move steadily from LOI to Closing with no missed steps or deadlines

-Stakeholders (buyers, brokers, lenders) receive clear and timely updates

-Deal documentation is accurate, complete, and audit-ready

-Bottlenecks are identified early and resolved quickly

-Execution KPIs (timeline adherence, process compliance) are consistently met



Responsibilities

-Own and manage deal execution from LOI through Closing

-Support LOI-stage activities by collecting, preparing, and reviewing key documents (LOIs, IOIs, financials)

-Coordinate closely with buying partners, brokers, lenders, diligence providers, and internal teams

-Enforce SOPs to maintain accuracy, compliance, and speed across the deal pipeline

-Track deal timelines, follow-ups, and status updates for reporting and stakeholder communication

-Support lender approvals, underwriting, purchase agreements, and closing activities in partnership with the Deal Execution Manager

-Identify risks, gaps, or delays and escalate them quickly

-Maintain organized deal documentation and execution checklists

-Spot process gaps and suggest improvements to increase efficiency and reduce errors



Requirements

-1+ years of experience in M&A, investment banking, private equity, lending, or related deal execution roles

-Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple deals simultaneously

-Excellent written and verbal communication for managing stakeholders

-Problem-solving mindset to troubleshoot deal bottlenecks quickly

-Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced, remote environment



Nice to Have

-Familiarity with SBA lending, deal structuring, or financial modeling

-Experience in high-volume deal execution or acquisitions

-Background supporting remote teams in fast-growth companies

-Comfort with tools like Slack, Google Workspace, Notion, or deal trackers



Why Join Us

-Fully remote setup

-Direct work on live M&A deals and real decision-making

-Hands-on across sourcing, diligence, LOI, and closing

-High-visibility role where your work impacts outcomes

-Room to grow fast as the firm scales

title: Appointment Setter: Home Services (Morning Shift, Bonus-Heavy) - Read How to Apply
description:
HOW TO APPLY (read this first)

We only read applications that do all 3 of these. If one is missing, we won't reply.

1. Start your message with the phrase "Five minutes or less."

2. Include a link to a 60-second voice recording (for example, Vocaroo). Pretend a homeowner just asked for a painting quote, and show us how you'd open the call.

3. In 2-3 sentences, tell us your best appointment-setting result with real numbers (for example: calls per day, appointments booked, show rate).



Schedule: Morning shift, Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM-1:00 PM Edmonton time. 30 hours a week.



Part-Time Appointment Setter: Home Services (Morning Shift, Bonus-Heavy, Growth Role)



Top performers earn $1,200-1,500+ USD/month.



About Us

J&B Quality Painters is a growing residential painting company in Edmonton, Canada. We do interior and exterior painting, cabinet refinishing and popcorn ceiling removal. We generate a steady flow of leads from homeowners who want work done. We need a fast, sharp setter who calls them right away, finds out what they need, and books qualified estimate appointments.



Our Core Values

Speed is king. A lead called in 5 minutes books; a lead called in an hour has already hired someone else.

Own the outcome. Your job isn't just dialing. It's a real appointment with a real homeowner who shows up.

Competitive greatness. You'll see your numbers every week, and you'll be paid for winning.



Your Mission

Turn every lead into a booked, qualified estimate appointment, as fast as possible.



What Good Looks Like



1. Speed to lead

Every new lead gets an automated text the moment it comes in.

You call every lead within 5 minutes during working hours, for both inbound and outbound leads.

Good looks like: 90% or more of leads called within 5 minutes.



2. Qualify every lead

Find out exactly what the homeowner wants done (rooms, exterior, cabinets, ceilings) and their timeline.

Confirm the project is worth $1,000 or more.

Confirm the address is in our Edmonton-area service zone and that the decision-maker will be there for the estimate.

Good looks like: every appointment you book is a real, qualified project.



3. Book and confirm the appointment

Book the estimate in our calendar (GoHighLevel).

Confirm it with the homeowner the day before so they show up.

Follow up with leads who didn't book, and with past leads, using our outbound scripts.

Good looks like: a high show rate, with appointments that turn into signed jobs.



Pay

Base: $500 USD per month, paid biweekly ($250 every second Friday).

Speed bonus: $50 per month when you call 90% or more of leads within 5 minutes.

Appointment bonus: $20 for every qualified appointment you book that actually happens (the estimate is completed with the homeowner).

Job bonus: an extra $25 when that appointment becomes a signed job.

Bonuses count only for appointments you personally book. They're paid monthly.

No bonus for appointments under $1,000, no-shows, or leads with false information.



Top performers earn $1,200-1,500+ USD/month. There's no cap on bonuses.



Growth

This role starts part-time. Setters who consistently hit their numbers can grow into more hours, more lead sources, and a senior setter role.



You're a Fit If You:

Speak clear, confident, natural English on the phone.

Have experience in appointment setting, inside sales or calling for a home services company (roofing, HVAC, solar, painting, renovation).

Are comfortable calling strangers fast and asking direct questions.

Track your own numbers and like being paid for results.

Have experience with GoHighLevel. (A plus, not required.)

title: Ecommerce Operations Coordinator | Logistics & Supply Chain
description:
We are a growing North American physical-product ecommerce business looking for an experienced Ecommerce Operations Coordinator to keep production, logistics, inventory, and warehouse follow-up organized and moving.



This is a remote, part-time role with potential for a long-term working relationship. You will work closely with our Operations Manager, handle routine work within our SOPs, investigate issues, and bring clear recommendations when decisions or approvals are needed.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



• Track production and purchase orders: follow up with suppliers on milestones, quantities, samples, payment stages, and written commitments. Flag delays early and keep trackers current.

• Coordinate inspections and freight: organize inspection timelines and reports, follow up on corrections, compare freight options, coordinate approved bookings, and track shipments and delivery dates.

• Keep inventory accurate: reconcile Shopify, warehouse, and 3PL records; investigate discrepancies; track incoming stock and stockout risks; and coordinate approved inventory transfers.

• Follow through with warehouses and 3PLs: resolve receiving and fulfillment issues, gather supporting information, and make sure action items reach completion.

• Support operational systems: maintain accurate Shopify inventory and location records, support retail or marketplace vendor portals, and organize shipping, claims, and compliance documents.

• Keep work organized: maintain ClickUp tasks, operational trackers, checklists, and SOPs so the team can see what is complete, what is delayed, and what needs a decision.



HOW WE WORK



We value someone who follows up proactively and investigates before escalating. When an issue needs approval, bring the facts, what you have already checked, realistic options, your recommendation, and the deadline for a decision.

title: IT MSP Level 1/2 Technician
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



We are hiring a full-time, experienced technical support professional to support our U.S.-based customers across managed IT, cloud services, business communications, VoIP, and emerging AI technologies.



This is not an entry-level help desk position. We are specifically looking for an experienced technician who already has a strong foundation in computers, Windows, Microsoft 365, networking, troubleshooting, and customer support. Experience with business telecommunications, VoIP, SIP, cloud PBX systems, or related communications technologies is especially valuable.



We are offering compensation at the experienced/expert level because we want someone who knows how to troubleshoot problems, think independently, communicate professionally with customers, and take ownership of issues through resolution.



Our company has nearly 30 years of experience in managed IT and cloud services. MSP support remains an important part of our business, but the next generation of the company is increasingly focused on Cloudspire Voice and Cloudspire AI. The person joining our technical team will work across both sides of the business.



### Must Have (intermediate to advanced)



- Microsoft 365 administration: users, licenses, mailboxes, shared mailboxes, MFA, and Exchange Online basics

- Networking: IP addressing and subnets, DNS, DHCP, routing basics, VPNs, and firewalls

- Diagnosing connectivity and call quality issues such as packet loss, latency, and jitter, and knowing how to test for them

- At least 2 years in a hands-on Level 1/Level 2 support role, ideally at an MSP



### Primary Responsibilities



- Provide Level 1 and Level 2 help desk and technical support

- Troubleshoot Windows desktops, applications, connectivity, printers, email, and general end-user issues

- Administer and troubleshoot Microsoft 365 environments

- Use our RMM platform (NinjaOne) for endpoint monitoring, management, remote access, patching, and support

- Work with our endpoint security platform (SentinelOne), including reviewing alerts and assisting with threat mitigation

- Prior NinjaOne or SentinelOne experience is a plus but not required; we will train you

- Troubleshoot networking issues involving TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, routers, firewalls, Wi-Fi, and general connectivity

- Work extensively within our ticketing system while following documented procedures, priorities, escalation requirements, and service standards

- Document troubleshooting, changes, customer communications, and resolutions thoroughly and accurately



### VoIP & Cloud Communications



Telecommunications is an increasingly important part of this position. You will support our Cloudspire Voice platform and work with business-class VoIP systems, including:



- VoIP and SIP troubleshooting

- Cloud PBX administration

- Phone provisioning and configuration

- Extensions, users, hunt groups, auto attendants, call queues, and call routing

- Troubleshooting call quality, registration, connectivity, and signaling issues

- Number provisioning and related telecom support

- Supporting physical phones, softphones, and mobile applications

- Working directly with customers to diagnose and resolve communications problems



Strong prior VoIP, SIP, PBX, UCaaS, or telecommunications experience will be highly valued.



### AI & Emerging Technology



Cloudspire AI is one of the fastest-growing areas of our business. Prior AI experience is **not required**, but it is a significant advantage.



The technician will have an opportunity to learn and work with:



- AI voice agents

- AI-powered customer service and communications

- Agent prompting and configuration

- Call flows and automation

- API integrations

- Troubleshooting AI conversations and behaviors

- Connecting AI agents with business systems and communications platforms



We are looking for someone who is interested in learning these technologies rather than someone who wants to remain exclusively in traditional desktop support.



### Customer Service & Communication



Customer satisfaction is extremely important to us.



You will communicate directly with U.S.-based customers by telephone, email, tickets, and remote support sessions throughout the workday. You must be professional, patient, courteous, and confident speaking with customers.



*** Excellent spoken and written English is required. ***



Attention to detail is also critical. Tickets must be documented correctly, instructions must be followed carefully, configurations must be verified, and customer requests must be completed accurately.



### Additional Skills That Can Create Opportunity



We are a small technology company, so people who bring skills beyond their primary role can have opportunities to contribute in other areas.



Experience or interest in any of the following would be considered a significant bonus:



- Technology sales or pre-sales

- Conducting product demonstrations

- Customer relationship management

- Business development

- Lead generation

- Digital marketing

- Social media or LinkedIn outreach

- Helping identify additional services that would benefit an existing customer



These skills are **not requirements for the position**. Technical ability and customer support come first. However, someone who combines strong technical knowledge with communication, business, or sales ability could become especially valuable as the company grows.



### The Person We Are Looking For



We want an experienced technician who can investigate a problem rather than immediately escalate it.



The right person should be comfortable moving between a Windows computer problem, a Microsoft 365 issue, a network problem, a VoIP call-routing issue, and a Cloudspire configuration during the same day.



You should be:



- Technically experienced and naturally curious

- Strong at troubleshooting and problem solving

- Comfortable working independently

- Extremely attentive to detail

- Organized with tickets and documentation

- Dependable and consistent

- Professional with customers

- Interested in VoIP, communications, cloud technology, and AI

- Willing to continue learning as our products and technology evolve



We are looking for someone who wants a stable, long-term position and who can become an important member of our technical team.



### Schedule



This is a full-time, fully remote position supporting U.S.-based customers.



**Monday through Friday**

**8:00 AM to 5:00 PM U.S. Eastern Time**



Reliable attendance and availability during these hours are essential.



### How to Apply (voice recording required)



Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed.



Record a 1 to 2 minute voice recording of yourself speaking to a customer as if you were on the phone: their whole office lost phone service 20 minutes ago, they're upset, and their clients are calling them. Explain what you're doing and what happens next.



Upload the recording to Vocaroo (vocaroo.com), Google Drive, or a similar service, make sure anyone with the link can listen, and paste the link at the top of your application message.



In your application message, also include:

- Your monthly pay expectation in USD

- Whether you can reliably work 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM U.S. Eastern, Monday to Friday

title: Financial Operations Manager / Controller (Commercial Accounting / Full-Cycle / Xero / CPA Preferred)
description:
Job Description



Company: Priority Haulage Limited

Job Title: Financial Operations Manager

Job Type: Part-Time

Job Hours: Starting at ~10 hours per week, plus additional hours during the monthly close process (~15 hours in the first 2-weeks of each month).

Job Location: Remote

Reports to: Financial Controller

Start Date: Immediately



About Priority Haulage



Priority Haulage is a reputable and reliable heavy machinery and equipment transport business based in Auckland, New Zealand. We specialise in the safe and efficient transportation of a wide range of civil machinery and heavy access equipment. 



Our company motto, “Your Assets, Our Priority”, reflects our commitment to the secure and dependable movement of our clients’ valuable machinery. We take pride in delivering a high level of client satisfaction through trusted service and operational excellence.



Job Summary



Priority Haulage is seeking a part-time, reliable and capable Financial Operations Manager to oversee day-to-day finance operations and support the monthly close process within a lean, systems-focused environment. 



Our finance function is built around well-documented processes, automation, and modern business systems. Routine bookkeeping and operational finance activities are supported by integrated and automated workflows, enabling the successful candidate to focus on financial accuracy, month-end reporting, continuous improvement, and optimising finance processes as the business grows.



Role Overview 



The primary responsibility of this role is the preparation and ownership of Priority Haulage's monthly management accounts and financial close process. Day-to-day financial operations support this objective by ensuring accurate, timely financial information is maintained throughout the month.



This role suits someone who is organised, dependable, systems-minded, and comfortable working autonomously within a structured operational environment. They will be confident using modern business systems and technology to optimise workflows and maintain strong financial controls.



Availability & Working Hours

This role requires consistent daily coverage during New Zealand morning business hours, with a structured morning schedule and flexible, outcome-focused afternoon support. Philippine Time (PHT) is typically 4 hours behind NZT (5 hours during NZ daylight saving).



Core Daily Hours

5:30 AM – 7:30 AM PHT (10:30 AM – 12:30 PM NZDT)



These hours are required each business day for core financial operations, daily processing, reconciliations, payroll coordination (Mondays), and communication with the New Zealand team.



Candidates should have some flexibility outside these hours to address urgent or time-sensitive matters, ensuring outstanding tasks are resolved before the following business day.



Month-End & Management Accounts Cycle

Additional hours are required during the monthly close process.



This includes:



• Close preparation during the final 1–2 business days of the month; and

• Completion of the monthly management accounts package within 8 working days following month-end.



During this period, responsibilities include:



• Reconciliations

• Working papers

• Management accounts preparation

• Review updates

• Close-related coordination



This workload is expected to average approximately ~15 hours per month depending on the cycle and business activity.



Flexible Support & Process Improvement

Outside core operational and month-end responsibilities, additional flexible hours may be available to support:



• Finance process improvements

• Reporting and documentation enhancements

• Workflow optimisation

• Additional reconciliation and operational finance support as required



These hours will be agreed based on operational priorities.



Job Responsibilities



Reporting & Compliance

• Prepare monthly management accounts, reconciliations, and reporting using Xero and CCH Workpapers, ensuring accuracy and timely month-end close. 

• Support GST preparation and adherence to New Zealand accounting standards. 

• Maintain financial data integrity, documentation standards, and contribute to ongoing reporting improvements.



Bookkeeping & Financial Operations

• Perform day-to-day bookkeeping activities in Xero.

• Manage the general ledger and maintain the chart of accounts.

• Complete all required financial reconciliations accurately and on time.



Payroll Administration

• Review approved driver timesheets.

• Process weekly payroll, submit payments, and manage IRD filings.

• Ensure payroll accuracy and compliance with New Zealand standards.



Client Management

• Issue client statements and prepare, manage, and communicate job quotations.

• Resolve client account, billing, and payment enquiries.

• Support accounts receivable and debt collection activities via the Client Services Coordinator.



Supplier Management

• Manage supplier accounts, payments, reconciliations, and resolve queries.

• Coordinate subcontractor bills and ensure accurate reconciliation.

• Oversee recurring subscriptions, licensing, registrations, and compliance costs.



Operational Support & Continuous Improvement

• Drive process improvements, system optimisation, and efficiency opportunities.

• Collaborate cross-functionally to support timely, high-quality workflows

• Partner with leadership to ensure accurate and reliable financial data while contributing to automation initiatives.



Required Experience & Capability



Applicants should demonstrate proven experience operating in a structured, deadline-driven finance environment.

• Minimum 7+ years’ hands-on accounting experience.

• Advanced proficiency in Xero is essential.

• Strong Microsoft Excel capability, with proven ability to reconcile and analyse data using XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, pivot tables, and financial modelling functions.

• Proven experience preparing monthly management accounts, conducting financial analysis, and supporting budgeting and forecasting activities.

• Working knowledge of New Zealand tax regulations, accounting standards, and statutory compliance requirements.

• Demonstrated ability to operate independently in a remote environment, with strong self-management, reliability, and a consistent track record of meeting deadlines without oversight.

• Strong ability to collaborate cross-functionally, supporting finance-related workflows across the business.

• High level of technical proficiency, including the Microsoft platform, with working familiarity in modern business tools.



Preferred Experience 



• CPA qualification required, preferably a Regular Member of PICPA, with a recognised tertiary qualification in accounting.

• Experience within New Zealand or Australian Chartered Accounting firms, including use of CCH Workpapers.

• Exposure to a commercial business environment, ideally within transport, logistics, or fleet-based operations.

• Experience using Notion, ChatGPT, workflow automation tools, and modern business systems to improve finance operations, documentation, and process efficiency.

• A relevant tertiary qualification in finance, business administration, or a related field.



Personal Attributes



• Highly organised and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple responsibilities reliably.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills, able to operate autonomously while contributing effectively in a remote team environment.

• Analytical and problem-solving capability, particularly in identifying, investigating, and resolving financial discrepancies.

• Proactive and improvement-oriented, with the ability to adapt, optimise workflows, and navigate operational change.

• Professional, client-focused mindset, demonstrating integrity, quality standards, and accountability in delivery.



Required Equipment and Setup



• Dedicated Workspace: Quiet, distraction-free home office suitable for video calls and focused work.

• Computer & Internet: Desktop PC or laptop with minimum Intel Core i5 processor, 8GB RAM (16GB preferred), Windows 10/11 compatibility, and a stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 10 Mbps upload/download).

• Monitor Setup: Dual monitors, or a laptop paired with an external monitor.

• Headset: Noise-cancelling headset for clear communication during virtual meetings where operating outside a fully quiet workspace.

• Webcam: High-quality external or integrated camera for video calls.

• Power Backup: Uninterruptible Power Supply (UPS) or generator ensuring at least 3 hours of operational uptime during outages.

• Internet Backup: Secondary internet connection (e.g., mobile data or alternative wireless) for uninterrupted connectivity.



Application Requirement

In your application submission, include the word “Motivated!” in the title.

description:
# Claims Specialist (m/f/d) – Remote



**Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term Independent Contractor**



## Join IronMaxx – #BEcomeMAXX!



At IronMaxx, we're passionate about sports nutrition, performance, and growth. As an international sports nutrition brand based in Germany, our products reach customers through leading retailers, discounters, drugstores, and online marketplaces across Europe.



As we continue to grow, we're looking for a Claims Specialist (m/f/d) to strengthen our international Finance team.



Are you detail-oriented, analytical, and persistent when it comes to resolving financial discrepancies? Do you enjoy investigating complex cases, challenging unjustified deductions, and ensuring that every claim is properly resolved?



Then we want to hear from you!



## Your Mission



As our Claims Specialist, you will take ownership of customer claims and payment deductions, ensuring that every deduction is investigated, supported by evidence, and resolved efficiently.



Working closely with our Claims Manager in Germany, you'll play an important role in protecting our revenue, improving financial accuracy, and building efficient claims management processes.



## Your Responsibilities



- **Claims Management:** Record, investigate, and manage customer deductions, including delivery shortages, returns, pricing discrepancies, promotional charges, and delivery penalties.

- **Dispute Resolution:** Review claims against contractual agreements, invoices, and delivery documentation, challenging unjustified deductions with clear supporting evidence.

- **Accounts Receivable Reconciliation:** Match customer payments, deductions, and outstanding invoices using SAP Business One, ensuring accurate documentation and resolution.

- **Stakeholder Coordination:** Collaborate with Sales, Logistics, Accounting, external warehouses, carriers, and suppliers to obtain documentation and resolve discrepancies.

- **Recovery Management:** Identify financial losses caused by logistics partners or suppliers and support recovery claims.

- **Case Ownership:** Independently manage your claims portfolio, prioritise cases, meet deadlines, and ensure accurate tracking through to closure.

- **Reporting & Analysis:** Prepare regular claims reports, monitor outstanding cases, identify recurring issues, and recommend process improvements.

- **Month-End Support:** Assist with reconciliations and ensure claims-related adjustments are accurately reflected in financial records.



## What You Bring



- Professional experience in **claims management, customer deductions, accounts receivable, dispute resolution, or order-to-cash processes**.

- Ideally, experience in **FMCG, consumer goods, retail, e-commerce, or logistics**.

- A strong understanding of customer deductions, payment discrepancies, and invoice reconciliation.

- Hands-on experience with ERP systems such as **SAP Business One, SAP, NetSuite, or Microsoft Dynamics**.

- Strong **Excel skills**, including XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, pivot tables, and working with large datasets.

- Excellent **English communication skills**, both written and spoken.

- An analytical, detail-oriented mindset with strong problem-solving abilities.

- A proactive and persistent approach, with the ability to independently manage cases and follow them through to resolution.

- Strong organisational skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with international teams.



**Nice to Have:**

- Experience with Amazon Vendor Central, retailer supplier portals, or EDI processes.

- Familiarity with European retail customers and logistics documentation.

- Basic German language skills.

- A degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Supply Chain, or a related field.



## What We Offer



- **100% Remote:** Work from your home office while collaborating with our team in Germany.

- **Long-Term Opportunity:** A full-time, long-term collaboration as an independent contractor.

- **International Environment:** Become part of a growing international sports nutrition brand.

- **Structured Onboarding:** Receive comprehensive training, clear procedures, and support from our experienced claims team.

- **Ownership & Impact:** Take responsibility for your own portfolio and actively contribute to improving our claims processes.

- **Growth & Development:** Be part of a growing Finance function with evolving processes, digital tools, and opportunities to contribute your ideas.

- **Collaborative Team:** Work closely with colleagues across Finance, Sales, and Logistics in an international environment.



## Key Details



- **Location:** 100% Remote (Home Office)

- **Employment Model:** Full-Time, Independent Contractor

- **Working Hours:** Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM German time

- **Reporting Line:** Claims Manager, Germany

- **Start Date:** As soon as possible



## Ready to #BEcomeMAXX?



If you're passionate about accuracy, enjoy solving complex financial challenges, and want to make a measurable impact in a growing international company, we'd love to get to know you!



**Apply now and become part of the IronMaxx team!**

title: BOOKKEEPER
description:
JOB OVERVIEW

We're hiring a detail-oriented Accounts Assistant to support a client's finance team remotely. You'll reconcile client pre-payments, refunds, and invoices across payment channels (Stripe, GoCardless, Stax, V12), process and verify supplier and engineer invoices in Xero, and investigate and report discrepancies. The ideal candidate has bookkeeping experience, hands-on Xero knowledge, strong attention to detail, and the confidence to question figures that don't add up.



Key Responsibilities



Client Pre-payments – Income & Refund Reconciliations

- Stripe pre-payments – the feed is automated, but a keen eye for detail is required to ensure transactions are matched accurately.

- GoCardless, Stax and V12 pre-payments – upload statements and reconcile transactions accurately.

- Reconcile customer refunds across payment channels.

- Report via slack daily income per payment channel, including any refunds processed.

   Identify, investigate and report any discrepancies.



Customer Invoices

- Reconcile customer pre-payments against customer invoices.

- Identify missing payments, incorrect payment allocations, overpayments and discrepancies.

- Report any issues via Slack to the relevant department and follow up where necessary.



  Supplier / Merchant Invoices

- Process supplier invoices within Xero. Most are generated automatically through our system, but some will need to be created manually from invoices received via the Accounts
.

- Verify each invoice against the original purchase order and information held within the customer's profile.

- Approve invoices where the information and charges are correct. 

- Where discrepancies are identified, log and report the issue and leave the invoice unapproved until resolved.

- Maintain an accurate record of outstanding supplier disputes and credits.

- Complete weekly and monthly supplier statement reconciliations to ensure balances are accurate.



Engineer / Subcontractor Invoices

- Review and reconcile engineer invoices against completed jobs and agreed rates.

- Check for any discrepancies, outstanding deductions, or adjustments.

- Prepare accurate invoices for approval and payment.

- Maintain records of outstanding queries and follow these through to resolution.



General Accounts Administration & Reporting

- Monitor the Accounts inbox and respond to routine queries.

- Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records.

- Provide daily and weekly updates on outstanding issues and discrepancies.

- Communicate effectively with the wider team via Slack.

- Escalate any unfamiliar or complex accounting queries rather than making assumptions.



Ideal Skills & Experience

- Previous bookkeeping or accounting experience.

- Experience using Xero.

- A good understanding of bank reconciliations, accounts payable, and accounts receivable.

- Excellent attention to detail and numerical accuracy.

- Good Excel / Google Sheets skills.

- Strong written English and communication skills.

- Ability to work independently, follow processes, and manage recurring deadlines.

- Confidence to question discrepancies and investigate issues rather than simply process transactions.

title: Podcast & Content VA (Coaching, Instagram & YouTube Shorts)
description:
Role Overview



Candidates with proven, verifiable podcast production experience, a strong eye for short-form content that performs, and a portfolio of hooks, intros and clips will be prioritised for this role.



A growing coaching business needs a part-time Podcast & Content VA to take full ownership of its weekly podcast production and short-form content engine. The podcast is the business's biggest growth engine, feeding both audience growth and coaching enquiries, but the process currently depends on the founder. The right person can listen to an episode and pick the hook, build a 20-second sizzle intro in the style of top podcasts such as The Diary of a CEO or The School of Greatness, and produce 15 or more on-brand clips a week.



Just as importantly, this person will turn a highly repeatable weekly workflow into their own checklist, so the founder only needs to upload the files and the rest happens. This is the most important attribute after podcast experience: someone who creates the list, not just ticks it off.



Success looks like a consistent Friday release, at least one and ideally three clips posted daily across Instagram and YouTube Shorts, growing views and followers, and the founder getting his time back. Video editing ability is a strong nice-to-have and gives the role a path to full-time.



What You'll Own



Podcast Production (Weekly)



Take the raw files after each recording and run the full post-production process through to release

Create a powerful 20-second "sizzle" intro for every episode that hooks the listener with the most important moments and looks visually strong

Edit the host's to-camera intro; the body of the episode needs only light editing

Create the episode thumbnail (AI tools like ChatGPT or Claude can be used)

Write the episode title and description

Publish the episode, or prepare it for publishing, with a target release day of Friday



Short-Form Clips & Social Content



Find the moments in each episode with viral potential that also stay on brand with the coaching message

Cut and edit clips of 20 to 30 seconds (sometimes up to 60), including on-screen captions and text that help a clip perform

Produce at least 15 clips a week, with the same clip posted to Instagram and YouTube Shorts

Post at least one clip a day, ideally three, directly or through a social scheduling platform

Batch clips ahead where possible using tools such as OpusClip and an AI video editor

Prepare clips for collaboration guests so they can post them on their own channels in the days after an episode

Chop up and post coaching videos about the business, which will increase next year

Track what performs and suggest improvements, with TikTok a possible new channel next year



Client Support & Admin



Send recap
s to coaching clients after sessions

Prepare the founder's week: for each client, pull together the previous session recording, notes and discussion points into Notion and link it to his calendar so he can review before each session

Design and format performance reports for corporate clients using numbers provided

Design other client-facing materials as needed

Send
s on the founder's behalf as directed

Pick up ad hoc tasks as the business restructures and grows



Systems & Process Ownership



Document the weekly podcast and content workflow as a checklist or SOP so it runs without daily task-setting

Build and manage a posting schedule and content cadence across platforms

Flag gaps early (for example, "we missed this bit, can you refilm it") and keep the founder on track with what is needed from him

Recommend better tools, AI workflows and shortcuts as content volume grows



What We're Looking For



Experience



Proven experience working on a podcast, ideally across the full process from raw recording to release (essential)

A portfolio we can review, including examples of hooks, intros and short-form clips you have produced

Experience producing short-form content for Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts, ideally for a personal brand, coach or thought leader

Video editing experience is a strong nice-to-have and opens a path to full-time

General VA or admin experience to cover the client support tasks



Communication Skills



Clear written English for client recap
s, podcast titles, descriptions and captions

Strong copywriting instincts for hooks and on-screen captions

Confident enough to push back, suggest ideas and ask for what you need



Technical Proficiency



Confident with AI clipping and editing tools such as OpusClip and similar AI editors

Comfortable using AI (ChatGPT, Claude) for thumbnails, titles and descriptions, working with it well rather than relying on it blindly

Video editing software experience (e.g. Premiere Pro, CapCut or similar)

Design tools for thumbnails and client reports, such as Canva

Notion, Google Calendar and
; comfortable with social media scheduling platforms



Organisational Skills



Manages a weekly production cycle and a daily posting cadence without slipping

Plans ahead and batches content so there is always a buffer

Keeps files, clips and client prep well organised so anything can be found quickly



Industry Understanding



Understands what makes content perform on Instagram and YouTube Shorts: hooks, pacing, captions and on-screen text

Understands how clips drive podcast listens, calls to action and coaching enquiries

Familiarity with the coaching, personal development or business podcast space is a plus



Non-Negotiables



Has the eye: can listen to a long conversation and instantly spot the 20 seconds that will stop the scroll

Proactive owner: owns the workflow end to end and comes with "here is what I do every week" rather than waiting for tasks

Brand guardian: chooses clips that build the coaching brand, not just views, and is open to feedback on what "on brand" means

Creative but grounded: brings creative flair while staying reliable on the admin and client support side

Consistent and reliable: hits the daily posting cadence and the Friday release week in, week out

Keeps up with fast-moving AI content tools and platform trends

Comfortable in a business that is restructuring and scaling, where ad hoc tasks will come up



Working Arrangements



Part-time to start: roughly 10-15 hours per week (around 3 hours a day)

Preferred working window is during the US morning or middle of the day, so candidates open to a part-time evening shift alongside other work are a good fit

Skilled specialists may complete the work in fewer hours; video editing skills create a path to full-time as content volume grows

Takes over a small set of existing admin tasks as part of the role



Why This Role



Genuine ownership of a podcast and content engine that directly drives audience growth and coaching clients

A founder who is happy to work with you to define what "on brand" looks like and who values your ideas

Hands-on use of the latest AI content tools in a business that embraces them

Content volume set to grow next year, with more guests, more coaching videos and possibly TikTok

A clear path to full-time for candidates with video editing skills



How to Apply



To be considered, please complete this form and include a short video introduction, along with a portfolio or examples of podcast intros, hooks and short-form clips you have produced. It helps us shortlist quickly

title: Video Editor (CapCut Only) | No Motion Graphics | $350/Month

We're not looking for someone who specializes in motion graphics or complicated effects. We're looking for someone with excellent movie B-roll selection, creative editing instincts, and a strong sense of pacing.





━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



JOB DETAILS



– Salary: $350 USD per month



– Payment: Every two weeks



– Output: 3 videos per week



– Deadline: One video every two working days



– Working Days: Monday to Saturday



– Software: CapCut Desktop



– Position: Long-term





━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



UNDERSTANDING THE WORKLOAD



IMPORTANT: Each finished video is approximately 21–25 minutes long, but ONLY 6–7 minutes require dedicated B-roll editing. There are NO motion graphics or complicated animations required.



Our videos consist of two main parts:



1. Narration (6–7 minutes total)



This is where most of your editing work happens. You'll find relevant movie scenes, funny reactions, and movie B-roll that visually support the narration. Your main focus is choosing the right clips and cutting them at the right moments.



2. Original Comedy Footage (Remaining Duration)



These are the original celebrity interviews, comedy performances, and funny moments. This portion requires minimal editing and timeline arrangement.



You are NOT expected to heavily edit an entire 21–25-minute video.



The main skills required are clip selection, creativity, pacing, and timing. No motion graphics, advanced animations, or heavy visual effects.





━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



– Excellent movie B-roll selection.



– Strong sense of pacing and timing.



– Ability to match visuals with the narrator's delivery.



– Creative understanding of comedic timing.



– Ability to follow editing samples and instructions.



– Consistent quality and reliability.



Important: Use actual movie scenes and relevant video footage as B-roll. No static images, GIFs, or cartoons.





━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



WEEKLY DELIVERY SCHEDULE



– Monday–Tuesday: Video 1



– Wednesday–Thursday: Video 2



– Friday–Saturday: Video 3



Each video has two working days for completion.





━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



HOW TO APPLY — TEST EDIT



Rather than selecting applicants based solely on their portfolios, we want to give everyone an opportunity to demonstrate their actual editing skills.



Inside the Google Drive folder below, you'll find two folders:



– Sample: Editing references demonstrating our expected standard for movie B-roll selection, pacing, and timing. Watch these carefully before starting.



– Audio: Five narration audio files for your test edit. Add relevant movie B-roll to each audio file, matching the editing style and quality demonstrated in the Sample folder.





Access Editing Samples & Test Audio Files Here:









Watch the editing samples carefully, then edit all five narration audio files using relevant movie B-roll.





WHAT WE WILL EVALUATE



– Clip Selection: How relevant and creative are your chosen movie clips?



– Pacing: Do your cuts follow the narrator's rhythm, emphasis, and delivery?



– Comedic Timing: Do your visuals enhance the humor?



– Attention to Detail: How closely can you follow the editing samples?



The test is specifically designed to evaluate your B-roll selection and pacing skills. It does not represent the entire video production process.





━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



IMPORTANT NOTICE



The test edit is unpaid and completely optional.



You're welcome to add a watermark to protect your work. If you're not comfortable completing an unpaid test, we completely respect your decision.



The test is for evaluation purposes only and will not be used as published content.



If your editing meets our standards, we'd be happy to welcome you to our team for a long-term position.





━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━



APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS



Simply send us:



– A Google Drive link to your completed test edits.



– Your availability to start.



No lengthy application or cover letter required. Let your editing speak for itself.



We look forward to seeing your work!

Previous experience selling technology, telecommunications, software, websites, digital marketing, or professional business services is highly preferred.



**COMPENSATION AND PERFORMANCE INCENTIVES**



We offer two compensation levels based on professional experience, demonstrated closing ability, and sales performance.

title: Patient Onboarding Specialist
description:
• Pay: USD 750 a month base, plus performance incentives with no cap. Our top performers take home USD 1,300 to 1,500 a month.

• Shift: Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM US Eastern (10 PM to 7 AM in Manila), with some weekend shifts for coverage

• Benefits: HMO from your third month, flexible paid time off

• Where: fully remote, from a quiet room at home



THE JOB

Health systems across the US refer older patients with heart failure or COPD to us, often after a hospital stay. You call them, explain in plain words how our doctors, nurses and respiratory therapists can care for them at home, and book their first video visit.



You make 45 to 60 calls a day. Most go to voi
, and about a dozen become real conversations. Some patients are wary, some are tired of doctors, some just want someone to listen. Your job is to help each one d
 whether to join, and to get them to a first visit within a week or so. Between calls you schedule visits, keep patient records up to date and work with our clinical team.



ABOUT ANSIBLEHEALTH

AnsibleHealth is a US medical group for people living with serious heart and lung disease, such as heart failure and COPD. Health systems and health plans send us their patients, often right after a hospital stay. Our own doctors, nurse practitioners, nurses and respiratory therapists then look after them at home by video and phone: we adjust medicines, treat flare-ups early, teach patients and their families, and are on call day and night. The goal is fewer trips back to the hospital. We were founded in 2021, are backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, First Round Capital and AlleyCorp, and our team works across the United States and the Philippines.



WHAT YOU NEED



• 2 or more years on the phone in customer service or healthcare

• Comfort with clinical topics: nursing or other clinical training, or healthcare work where you talked with patients about their conditions

• Clear spoken English that a US patient understands the first time

• A quiet room, internet of 30 Mbps or faster, and a backup for outages

• Availability for this shift for the long term

A healthcare degree, US healthcare accounts, sales or appointment-setting experience, or Spanish are a plus.



This is a phone job with daily targets, not back-office or

A CALL, FOR EXAMPLE

An 81-year-old patient calls ten minutes before his video visit. His tablet screen is dark and he is not sure it is charged. You stay calm, find out what he sees, get the tablet charging and on Wi-Fi, and get him into the visit before his nurse gives up waiting.

Our patients are mostly older adults at home in the US with heart failure or COPD. They see their care team by video on a tablet we send them, and their pulse oximeter and blood pressure monitor send readings to us. When something stops working, you are the person who fixes it, often by walking a patient who is not comfortable with technology through it one step at a time.



You take about 50 calls a day from patients and clinicians: a tablet that will not join a visit, a device that stopped sending readings, a clinician who needs help in Athenahealth. You own each problem until it is solved, and you write clear reports for our engineers when something needs a fix on their side.



ABOUT ANSIBLEHEALTH

AnsibleHealth is a US medical group for people living with serious heart and lung disease, such as heart failure and COPD. Health systems and health plans send us their patients, often right after a hospital stay. Our own doctors, nurse practitioners, nurses and respiratory therapists then look after them at home by video and phone: we adjust medicines, treat flare-ups early, teach patients and their families, and are on call day and night. title: Medical Virtual Assistant (Fixed Salary)
description:
• Pay: USD 900 a month, fixed. This role has no commission or incentive pay.

• Shift: Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM US Eastern (10 PM to 7 AM in Manila), with some weekend shifts for coverage

• Benefits: HMO from your third month, flexible paid time off

• Where: fully remote, from a quiet room at home



A CALL, FOR EXAMPLE

Your first call of the day is to a woman in her seventies with COPD. Her health system referred her to us last week. She asks how you got her number. You explain who we are and how our team can help her stay well at home, answer her questions, and book her first visit.



THE JOB

Health systems across the US refer older patients with heart failure or COPD to us, often after a hospital stay. You call them, explain in plain words how our doctors, nurses and respiratory therapists can care for them at home, and book their first video visit.



You make 45 to 60 calls a day. Most go to voicemail, and about a dozen become real conversations. Some patients are wary, some are tired of doctors, some just want someone to listen. Your job is to help each one decide whether to join, and to get them to a first visit within a week or so. Between calls you schedule visits, keep patient records up to date and work with our clinical team.



ABOUT ANSIBLEHEALTH

AnsibleHealth is a US medical group for people living with serious heart and lung disease, such as heart failure and COPD. Health systems and health plans send us their patients, often right after a hospital stay. Our own doctors, nurse practitioners, nurses and respiratory therapists then look after them at home by video and phone: we adjust medicines, treat flare-ups early, teach patients and their families, and are on call day and night. The goal is fewer trips back to the hospital. We were founded in 2021, are backed by Bessemer Venture Partners, First Round Capital and AlleyCorp, and our team works across the United States and the Philippines.



WHAT YOU NEED



• 2 or more years on the phone in customer service or healthcare

• Comfort with clinical topics: nursing or other clinical training, or healthcare work where you talked with patients about their conditions

• Clear spoken English that a US patient understands the first time

• A quiet room, internet of 30 Mbps or faster, and a backup for outages

• Availability for this shift for the long term

A healthcare degree, US healthcare accounts, sales or appointment-setting experience, or Spanish are a plus.



This is a phone job with daily targets, not back-office or email work. If you like talking with people and helping them say yes to care, you will do well here.



HOW TO APPLY (ABOUT 15 MINUTES)



1. Apply only at https://www.ansiblehealth.com/careers/jobs/medical-virtual-assistant-fixed-salary/apply?ref=3yj4hab6 . Applications sent any other way are not reviewed.

2. Answer a few quick questions. When the form asks for the word from this posting, type LUNGS.

3. Record your voice on the form: read three lines from a real call, then answer a patient in your own words (about five minutes).

4. Give your earliest start date and the notice you owe your current employer.

If you are shortlisted, we email you a link to book a 15-minute call with our recruiter.

title: Shopify Developer (Frontend) - Liquid, JavaScript, HTML & CSS
description:
We're a growing ecommerce SaaS company looking for an experienced Shopify developer to support ongoing custom development across a portfolio of Shopify stores.



You'll work directly with our team and clients to develop custom Shopify components, implement CRO improvements, customise themes and roll out functionality across multiple stores.



This is NOT a Shopify store-building, virtual assistant, product listing or page-builder role. You must be comfortable writing code from scratch, working with unfamiliar codebases and debugging frontend issues.



We're looking for someone interested in a long-term working relationship rather than a one-off project.



Responsibilities

- Develop custom Shopify Liquid sections, snippets, blocks and components from scratch.

- Build reusable, configurable components using Shopify's JSON schema and theme settings.

- Develop custom frontend functionality using vanilla JavaScript.

- Implement responsive CRO components, including product gallery badges, promotional banners, bundle displays, countdown timers and product page elements.

- Integrate custom components with our proprietary JavaScript-based Shopify software.

- Port existing functionality between different Shopify themes while maintaining compatibility.

- Work with multiple theme drafts and manage changes without introducing regressions.

- Debug JavaScript errors, CSS conflicts, rendering issues and theme-specific compatibility problems.

- Communicate directly with clients, provide development estimates and track time against individual tasks.



Essential Technical Requirements

- Shopify Liquid

- Strong understanding of Liquid objects, filters, tags, loops and conditional logic.

- Experience developing custom sections, snippets and blocks from scratch.

- Understanding of section schemas, presets, dynamic sources and global theme settings.

- Experience working with settings_schema.json, settings_data.json, JSON templates and theme.liquid.

- Understanding of Shopify metafields, product objects, variants and collection objects.

- Ability to work with both Online Store 2.0 and legacy Shopify themes.



JavaScript

- DOM manipulation and event handling.

- Asynchronous programming, promises, async/await and Fetch API.

- Experience with dynamically rendered content and event delegation.

- Understanding of browser storage, cookies and JavaScript execution lifecycles.

- Ability to debug race conditions, asynchronous rendering issues and duplicate event listeners.

- Experience with browser developer tools, network requests and performance debugging.



HTML & CSS

- Semantic HTML and accessible frontend development.

- Responsive layouts using Flexbox, CSS Grid and media queries.

- Strong understanding of CSS specificity, inheritance, positioning and stacking contexts.

- Ability to implement components from screenshots or design references without relying on page builders.

- Ability to identify and resolve styling conflicts across different themes.



Development Practices

- Ability to read, understand and modify existing code written by other developers.

- Write clean, maintainable and reusable code.

- Understand the performance implications of frontend changes.

- Experience with Git, version control and Shopify CLI is highly desirable.

- Ability to independently investigate technical issues rather than relying on step-by-step instructions.



Working Arrangement

- Ongoing freelance development work.

- Hourly compensation with time-tracking software.

- Flexible working hours based on incoming requests.

- Direct communication with our team and clients through Slack.

- Training on our proprietary software and integration architecture.

- Opportunity for increased hours as the business grows.



Nice to have:

- Experience with Shopify Section Rendering API



How to Apply:



Please submit your CV along with samples of your previous development work, portfolio or GitHub profile.



1) Do you have at least 2 years of hands-on Shopify Liquid development experience?

2) Can you develop custom Shopify sections, snippets and blocks from scratch?

3) Are you proficient in vanilla JavaScript (ES6+), HTML and CSS?

4) Do you have experience working with Shopify theme schemas and JSON templates?

5) Do you have experience with the Shopify Section Rendering API and AJAX Cart API?

6) Can you develop custom Shopify functionality without relying on third-party apps or page builders?

7) Do you have experience with Git?

8) How many hours per week are you available?

9) Are you comfortable working on an ad hoc, hourly basis, where workload varies depending on the development requests we receive?

title: Video Team Manager & Quality Checker (E-commerce Ads)
description:
We're an e-commerce company running several online stores across Europe. All of our ads are videos made by our in-house team of video editors, and we're looking for a sharp, organised manager to lead one of our editing teams and any other adhoc tasks.



Our editors are split into two teams. You'll manage your own team of editors, while our other manager runs the second team. You'll mainly work independently but also working alongside the AD analyst/product researcher to d
 on what tasks to assign next.



What you'll do:

- Plan your team's work for the next day. Our product researcher and ads analyst will tell you which products need ads and which ads need refreshing, and you d
 what gets made and in what order

- Most of the work is new ads for new products, plus fresh ads for products that are already winning

- Assign video projects to your editors and make sure every deadline is met

- Review every video before it goes live and check it for mistakes: captions, spelling, timing, cuts, music, product shots and overall quality

- Send clear revision notes to your editors and check that every fix is done properly

- Keep track of your editors' hours and overtime

- Upload and publish the finished ads (easy to learn, we'll show you how)



Captions and languages:

Our ads run across Europe, so most of our videos have captions and voiceovers in Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Finnish, German and Dutch. You don't need to speak these languages, but you need to be very good at comparing captions against the script word for word and spotting anything that doesn't match: missing words, typos, wrong letters (å, ä, ö, ø, æ, ü), captions out of sync or cut off on screen.



This is the most important part of the role. If a mistake gets past you, it goes live in front of thousands of customers.



You should have:

- Management experience: leading a team, planning work, assigning tasks and following up

- Experience with video production or editing, so you know what a good ad looks like and can spot mistakes quickly

- A very keen eye for detail

- E-commerce or social media ads experience is a big plus

- Clear written English, your revision notes need to be easy for editors to follow

- Reliability: you show up every day, stay on top of your team and deliver on time



What we offer:

- $1,200/month for 6 hours a day, 7 days a week

- A raise after 2–3 months when the work is good

- Monthly bonus based on your team's performance:

  - Few or no mistakes making it into live ads

  - Deadlines met and your team delivering on time

  - Strong, consistent output from your editors

- Reliable, long-term work with flexible hours

- Room to grow into a bigger role as we scale

3. Tell us about your experience with QC work

title: Property Utility Specialist
description:
What This Role Is About:



The Property Utility Specialist is responsible for the end-to-end management of utility billing, onboarding, and invoice processing for one of our clients. This role ensures utilities are properly onboarded, bills are processed accurately, autopay/e-billing is implemented, and all related systems and controls are maintained with integrity. The ideal candidate is highly detailed, process-oriented, comfortable with multiple stakeholders and systems, and thrives in a fast-paced asset management environment.



Your Main Responsibilities:



1. Utility Invoice Processing

Receive utility invoices and ensure the utility folder is resolved to zero open items by end of day.

Enter utility invoices per property under the correct name.

Input utilities into the property management software (e.g., AppFolio) using proper GL accounts and property codes.

Maintain passwords/logins for utility accounts

Immediately notify Accounting Supervisor & Treasury Supervisor of any invoice or billing errors.

Provide a daily End-of-Day report to Accounting Supervisor & Treasury Supervisor documenting utility bills entered.

Communicate with the Accounting & Treasury Supervisors when a new utility vendor must be created to process invoices.

Collaborate with Accounting & Treasury Supervisors to resolve any utility invoice anomalies (e.g., unusual charges, late fees).

Update the “BPO Utilities” channel each day with current status and any late fees observed during bill entry.

Assist in setting up utility accounts on autopay linked to the property’s bank account.

Assist in enrolling utility accounts to e-billing

Assist in compiling utility data (usage, invoices, etc.) upon request.

Participate in daily bank proofing, ensuring utility items are correctly reported

2. Utility Onboarding for New/Transitioning Properties

Support the onboarding of utilities for properties ensuring 100% completion prior to the transition date.

Obtain from outgoing management/ownership the list of utilities requiring transition (electric, water/sewer, gas, trash, phone/internet).

Ensure all new utility accounts are set up under the correct property name

Ensure utility account logins are created and stored in the Utility/Vendor Account Workbook folder.

Document each onboarding step on the Onboarding Checklist with supporting documentation 
 confirmation, phone confirmation, contract copies).

Store utility transition confirmations for the property being onboarded.

Escalate any onboarding barriers (missing information, deposits required, ownership paperwork missing) to the Accounting & Treasury Supervisor immediately.

3. Flexible and Adaptable Work

As jurisdictions, utility provider practices, lease terms, and internal processes evolve, adapt to changing workflows and procedures.

Remain responsive to new property acquisitions, portfolio growth or other changes.

What We’re Looking For:

At least 2 years of experience in utility billing, invoice processing, or property-management accounting highly desirable.

Strong sense of ownership and proactive communication — someone who will immediately report any problem or barrier (e.g., utility account issues, vendor set-up delays, login access problems) to the appropriate supervisor.

Prior experience using AppFolio or similar property management accounting software is advantageous.



Technical Skills:

Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook) and ability to learn new systems quickly.

Experience managing passwords/logins securely using tools like Keeper Security or similar.

Familiarity with electronic billing and autopay setup processes.

Attention to Detail & Process-Oriented: Proven track record of accurate data entry, following checklists, meeting deadlines (e.g., zero open items by EOD).

Communication & Collaboration: Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to coordinate with internal teams and external utility providers.

Problem Solving: Ability to identify anomalies, escalate appropriately and follow through to resolution.

Organizational Skills: Ability to manage multiple properties/portfolios, daily tasks, reporting requirements and onboarding workflows concurrently.

Adaptability: Comfortable working in a dynamic environment where policies and programs may change.

Confidentiality & Integrity: Handle login credentials, financial information and vendor accounts securely and responsibly.



Nice to Haves:



Prior experience in a real-estate asset management company or multifamily/residential portfolio.

Experience in handling tenant billing and administrative fee processes.

Comfortable working under minimal supervision with defined workflows and checklists.

Initiative to improve processes, suggest efficiencies and maintain a clean inbox/folder system.
