title: Social Media Manager / Content Strategist
description:
Position Type: Part-Time, Long-Term

Schedule: Approximately 30 hours per week, Monday through Friday

Compensation: $6 USD per hour

Bonuses: $150 after six months and $300 after twelve months, based on continued service and satisfactory performance



About Southwind Marketing



Southwind Marketing is a U.S.-based marketing and communications agency serving municipalities, economic development organizations, tourism organizations, small businesses, and other clients throughout the United States.



We specialize in website design and development, digital marketing, search engine optimization (SEO), social media management, paid advertising, photography, video production, and marketing technology solutions.



We're looking for a creative, organized, dependable, and experienced Social Media Manager & Content Strategist to join our growing team.



This is not simply a position where you create graphics and schedule posts. We're looking for someone who understands marketing strategy, writes strong content, manages multiple client accounts, coordinates creative production, analyzes performance, and takes ownership of their responsibilities.



You'll work directly with our Principal Consultant and collaborate with our graphic designers, developers, and other team members.



We want someone who can help us improve our clients' online presence while making our internal social media operations more efficient and organized.



Key Responsibilities



1. Social Media Management



Manage social media for Southwind Marketing and approximately five additional client brands.



Develop, organize, and maintain monthly social media content calendars.



Create, schedule, and manage posts across
, Instagram, LinkedIn, Google Business Profile, and other platforms as assigned.



Ensure content is prepared, reviewed, and scheduled ahead of publishing deadlines.



Maintain each client's unique brand identity, voice, and audience.



Monitor comments, messages, engagement, and incoming inquiries.



Coordinate revisions and ensure approved changes are completed promptly.



Manage content scheduling and approvals through Cloud Campaign, our social media management platform.



Identify scheduling conflicts, missing creative assets, and potential delays before they become problems.



2. Content Strategy & Copywriting



Develop monthly content strategies based on client goals, target audiences, analytics, and industry trends.



Write engaging, natural, professional captions in American English.



Develop compelling headlines, calls to action, and relevant hashtags.



Adapt content appropriately for different platforms rather than publishing identical captions everywhere.



Research content opportunities for municipalities, economic development organizations, tourism destinations, contractors, and small businesses.



Turn client projects, website articles, case studies, photography, and other materials into engaging social media content.



Identify opportunities for educational content, promotional campaigns, client showcases, and lead generation.



Recommend improvements to underperforming content.



Ensure content is accurate, relevant, and aligned with each client's objectives.



We want someone who can think strategically about what to post, why we're posting it, and what we want the audience to do next.



3. Graphic Design & Creative Coordination



Create professional social media graphics using Canva, Figma, or similar tools.



Develop basic graphics, promotional posts, carousels, and branded content.



Coordinate with our graphic designer and video editor on more advanced creative projects.



Prepare clear creative briefs that identify the required visuals, headlines, copy, sizes, and deadlines.



Review graphics and videos for quality, accuracy, brand consistency, and readability.



Use actual client photography, screenshots, and project materials whenever appropriate.



Organize and maintain creative assets for each client.



Identify opportunities to improve visual content and avoid repetitive or generic designs.



Help develop concepts for Reels and short-form videos.



You do not need to be an advanced video editor or web developer. However, you must understand what makes social media content visually engaging and be able to direct creative production.



We value originality, attention to detail, and good design judgment.



4. Analytics, Reporting & Optimization



Monitor 
 across
, Instagram, LinkedIn, Google Business Profile, and other assigned platforms.



Track impressions, reach, engagement, website clicks, inquiries, and other relevant metrics.



Prepare concise weekly performance updates and monthly reports.



Identify which posts and campaigns are performing well and explain why.



Recommend improvements to posting schedules, content formats, captions, and creative approaches.



Conduct competitor research to identify trends, opportunities, and successful content formats.



Use available website analytics and SEO insights to improve social media strategy.



Help connect social media activity to measurable business results, including website traffic and lead generation.



We are not interested in simply posting content to fill a calendar. We want to understand whether that content is helping our clients achieve their goals.



5. Project Management & Communication



This is one of the most important parts of the position.



We need someone who takes ownership of assigned work and communicates proactively.



Responsibilities include:



Manage multiple client calendars and competing deadlines.



Keep projects organized and maintain accurate task statuses.



Communicate regularly with management and other team members.



Follow up with designers or other team members when creative assets are outstanding.



Request information, photography, approvals, and other materials before they are urgently needed.



Provide clear updates on work completed, work in progress, and upcoming deadlines.



Notify management promptly if a deadline may be missed.



Recommend solutions when challenges arise.



Maintain accurate records of actual working hours.



Communicate schedule changes, absences, and availability in advance whenever reasonably possible.



We understand that unexpected circumstances happen. What matters is clear communication, dependability, and taking responsibility for keeping work moving.



Our goal is to have someone who can independently manage day-to-day social media operations without requiring constant reminders or follow-up.



Required Qualifications



Minimum of two years of professional social media management experience.



Previous experience managing social media for multiple businesses or client accounts.



Excellent written and spoken English.



Strong copywriting skills, especially writing natural and engaging American English.



Experience developing monthly social media content calendars.



Proficiency with
, Instagram, LinkedIn, and Google Business Profile.



Experience creating graphics using Canva, Figma, or similar design tools.



Strong understanding of social media content strategy, hashtags, calls to action, and audience engagement.



Experience reviewing social media analytics and preparing reports.



Strong attention to detail, including spelling, grammar, branding, and accuracy.



Ability to organize competing priorities and consistently meet deadlines.



Excellent communication skills and the ability to work independently.



Reliable internet connection, computer, and remote work environment.



Preferred Qualifications

Previous experience working for a U.S.-based marketing agency.



Experience managing five or more client accounts.



Familiarity with Cloud Campaign or similar social media scheduling platforms.



Experience using Meta Business Suite.



Experience with Figma and Canva.



Familiarity with Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, or Ubersuggest.



Basic knowledge of SEO and digital marketing.



Experience with Reels, short-form video concepts, and content repurposing.



Familiarity with WordPress websites.



Experience using GoHighLevel or other CRM platforms.



Experience creating content for professional services, local government, economic development, tourism, or home service businesses.

What Success Looks Like



First 30 Days



Learn Southwind's services, clients, brands, and internal processes.



Become familiar with our content calendars and scheduling platform.



Review existing social media accounts and identify opportunities for improvement.



Begin managing assigned content and coordinating with our creative team.

Consistently meet agreed-upon deadlines.



First 60 Days

Coordinate content production with designers and other team members.



Create high-quality captions and basic graphics without extensive revisions.



Maintain organized scheduling and approval processes.



Provide meaningful performance reports and recommendations.



Demonstrate an understanding of the differences between our various client brands.



First 90 Days



Take ownership of day-to-day social media operations.



Consistently deliver quality content across assigned accounts.



Proactively manage deadlines, creative requests, and revisions.



Demonstrate improvements in content quality, organization, and campaign performance.



Identify opportunities to improve social media strategy and internal efficiency.



Require minimal day-to-day supervision while maintaining strong communication with management.



Performance will be evaluated based on quality, consistency, reliability, communication, strategic thinking, and demonstrated results.



Schedule & Work Expectations



This is a remote, part-time position requiring approximately 30 hours per week, Monday through Friday.



Some overlap with U.S. Central Time business hours is required for collaboration, meetings, and communication.



The specific working schedule will be established during onboarding.



Team members are expected to accurately track their working hours and communicate any changes to their agreed-upon schedule.



We value flexibility, but we also need consistency and dependable communication because our clients rely on us to meet deadlines.



Compensation & Benefits



Starting Pay: $6 USD per hour.

title: Creative Content Specialist — Graphic Design & Copywriting | Online Coaching Industry | $10 USD/hour
description:
PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING:

- Previous experience creating content within the online coaching industry is ESSENTIAL.

- We are NOT looking for AI-generated graphics, imagery or copy. We are looking for genuine human creativity, original ideas and authentic content.

- Your portfolio must demonstrate strong static graphic design and copywriting skills.



We're a growing UK-based agency specialising in Meta ads and high-converting sales funnels for established online coaches, mentors, course creators and female-led personal brands, predominantly in the US.



We're looking for an exceptionally creative individual who combines strong graphic design skills with compelling copywriting and a genuine understanding of the online coaching industry.



We LOVE authentic, personality-led, native-looking content. Think bold typography, Notes app-style graphics, storytelling carousels, casual iPhone-style content, powerful messaging and creative concepts that feel natural within someone's Instagram feed.



We don't want corporate-looking advertisements, generic Canva templates, ChatGPT-generated copy or AI-generated graphics. We want someone who genuinely understands how to capture a brand's personality and bring it to life through original, human-created content.



Your responsibilities:

- Creating scroll-stopping static graphics for Meta advertising campaigns.

- Writing compelling hooks, headlines, ad copy and carousel copy.

- Developing original creative concepts and messaging angles.

- Creating storytelling carousels and Instagram-style graphics.

- Designing Notes app-style, text-led and native-looking creatives.

- Creating testimonial, client transformation and social proof graphics.

- Turning client photography and existing content into engaging ad creatives.

- Researching relevant content trends and creative inspiration within the online coaching industry.

- Adapting both visuals and copy to different client brand identities and personalities.

- Creating multiple creative variations for split testing.

- Editing short-form video content where required.

- Managing assigned tasks and deadlines through Asana.



What we're looking for:

- Previous experience creating content for online coaches, mentors or course creators — this is non-negotiable.

- An exceptional eye for design, typography, layout and aesthetics.

- Strong copywriting skills and the ability to write in different brand voices.

- Excellent written English, particularly for a US-based audience.

- Strong Canva or equivalent graphic design skills.

- A natural understanding of Instagram content trends within the coaching industry.

- An understanding of buyer psychology and what makes someone stop scrolling, engage and take action.

- The ability to create both beautifully branded graphics and intentionally casual, organic-looking content.

- Genuine creative flair, originality and independent thinking.

- Strong attention to detail and excellent communication skills.

- Ability to work independently and proactively bring creative ideas to the table.



Our approach to AI:



We are specifically hiring for HUMAN creativity.



We do not want AI-generated copy, AI-generated imagery or AI-generated designs. All creative work and copy must be authentically created by you.



We want someone who can think creatively, understand the nuances of a brand, write with personality and produce content that feels genuinely human.



Please note: This is primarily a static graphic design, creative content and copywriting role. It is NOT a video editing-only role, social media management position or Meta ads management role.



Role details:

- Rate: $10 USD per hour.

- Location: Philippines.

- Fully remote with flexible working hours.

- Ongoing freelance contractor position.

- Paid for actual hours worked, with no guaranteed minimum hours.

- Predominantly asynchronous communication.

- Opportunity for increased hours as the agency grows.

- A paid creative trial will form part of the recruitment process.



How to apply:



Please include the following:



- At least five examples of static graphics or carousels you have personally designed for online coaches, mentors or course creators.

- Examples of copy you have personally written, including hooks, captions, carousel copy or ad copy.

- Links to Instagram accounts or coaching brands you have previously created content for, where available.

- A short Loom video introducing yourself and walking us through your previous creative work. We'd love to hear about your creative process and the thinking behind your designs.

- Details of the design tools you use.

- Your current availability and confirmation that you are happy with the hourly rate.



Please include the word WILD at the beginning of your application.



We're looking for someone who genuinely LOVES creating content, has exceptional creative taste, understands the online coaching industry and wants to build a long-term working relationship with a growing specialist agency.



Please ensure your application includes relevant static graphic design and copywriting examples from within the online coaching industry. A portfolio consisting solely of video editing will not be considered.
